scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh, I guess all is going well for you. So how has everything else been?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
哦，看来你一切都好。那其他事情呢？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I may be being overly sensitive, but it feels like something might happen soon. Aaah, don't mind me. It's no big deal. Maybe I'm just being weird.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我可能有点过于敏感了，但感觉最近会发生什么事。啊，别在意我。没什么大不了的。也许我只是有点奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Right, right, let me play a song for you. Would you care to listen?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
对了，让我为你演奏一首曲子吧。你想听听吗？

scripts.text: Sure, why not~
scripts.translation: 好啊，为什么不呢~

scripts.text: How about some news?
scripts.translation: 有什么新闻吗？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
So, which song
would you like to hear?
Go ahead, pick one~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
那么，你想听哪首歌呢？
请随意挑选~

scripts.text: Bragi's Poem
scripts.translation: 布拉吉的诗篇

scripts.text: Eternal Chaos
scripts.translation: 永恒的混沌

scripts.text: Assassin in the Sunset
scripts.translation: 夕阳下的刺客

scripts.text: Der Ring des Nibelungen
scripts.translation: 尼伯龙根的指环

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Bragi's Poem!
What a good choice!
I must say this song
represents the
heart of a poet!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
布拉吉的诗篇！
真是好选择！
不得不说，这首歌
代表了
诗人的心！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Eternal Chaos...
Sounds too chaotic.
By the way, I wonder
what the title really
means. Is it the chaos
of hell or our own reality?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
永恒的混沌...
听起来太混乱了。
顺便问一下，
我不明白
标题到底
是什么意思。是地狱的
混沌，还是我们
现实的混沌？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Assassin in the Sunset!
Yes, no one looks cooler than an Assassin, the bringer of death, standing alone in the sunset! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
夕阳下的刺客！
没错，没有人比刺客更酷了，
这位死亡使者，
独自站在夕阳下！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Der Ring des Nibelungen.....
Okay, are you ready to listen?
Hum hum hum....
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
尼伯龙根的指环.....
好了，你准备好听了吗？
哼...哼...哼....

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFRheingold...
Hidden in the Rhein river.
If made into a ring,
Could rule the world~^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF莱茵黄金...
隐藏在莱茵河中。
若铸成指环，
便可统治世界~^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFProtected by a spell
Cursing its thief
To never find love.
Alberich had known
Nonetheless stole it.
Love was forsaken for power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF受咒语保护
诅咒其窃贼
永远无法找到爱情。
阿尔贝里希
明知故犯地偷走了它。
为了权力，爱情被抛弃。^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFGiants built beautiful Valhalla
Matrimony with Freya
Goddess of beauty
Their supposed payment.
In not receiving it
They forcefully took her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF巨人建造了美丽的瓦尔哈拉
与女神芙蕾雅
美丽的女神
作为他们约定的报酬。
在未能得到她时
他们强行夺走了她。^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFThe gods would
give Alberich's treasure
To the Giants for Freya's return.
Loki tricked Alberich,
Stealing his ring or power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF众神将
阿尔贝里希的宝藏
交给巨人，以换回芙蕾雅。
洛基欺骗了阿尔贝里希，
偷走了他的指环或权力。^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFBut Alberich cursed his ring
Before it was returned to him,
Envy and death would
befall its wearers.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF但阿尔贝里希诅咒了他的指环
在它被归还之前，
嫉妒和死亡
将降临于佩戴者。^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFThe ring was given to the giants
Freya was returned to the gods
The giants killed themselves
Fighting over the rheingold,
Victims of Alberich's curse~^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF指环被交给了巨人
芙蕾雅被归还给众神
巨人们自相残杀
争夺莱茵黄金，
成为阿尔贝里希诅咒的受害者~^000000

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Some news you say..
What kind of news do
you wish to hear about?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
听说你有消息要分享？
你想听哪方面的消息呢？

scripts.text: About Prontera!
scripts.translation: 关于普隆德拉！

scripts.text: About coastal areas.
scripts.translation: 关于沿海地区。

scripts.text: Is the desert still hot?
scripts.translation: 沙漠还是很热吗？

scripts.text: How about the borderlands?
scripts.translation: 边境地区怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
What?! Prontera?!
Can you not see that the front
gate of Prontera is right before you? You should at least know where you are, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
什么？！普隆德拉？！
你没看到普隆德拉的正门就在你面前吗？
冒险者，你至少该知道自己在哪吧。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Anyways, I have one interesting news about Prontera. But, it's a secret. Shh! Are you... Single?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
总之，我有一条关于普隆德拉的有趣消息。
不过，这是个秘密。嘘！你...是单身吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
If so, go visit the tavern. I met a guy there who took to me a nice place. Oh yes. He took me to 'the place' where singles are forbidden~!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
如果是的话，去酒馆看看吧。
我在那里遇到了一个家伙，他带我去了一处不错的地方。
哦对了。他带我去的是“单身禁止入内”的地方~！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Coastal areas?
That's a funny question. I mean, there's Alberta and a few other places where you can see the sea.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
沿海地区？
这问题真有趣。我是说，艾尔贝塔和其他几个地方都能看到海。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
To the southwest there's
Kokomo Beach. But, I suppose it's too dangerous just to go there to take a stroll.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
西南方有克克魔海边。
不过，我觉得光是去那里散步就太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Kokomo Beach is a large
expanse of sand. The nearby water is filled with sea animals, so you can enjoy catching Shellfishes.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
克克魔海边是一大片沙滩。
附近的水域里充满了海洋生物，所以你可以尽情捕捉贝类。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
However, there are always bullies in that kind of place. Once, I met a threatening looking hoodlum with red spiky hair.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
不过，那种地方总是会有恶霸。
有一次，我遇到了一个长相凶恶、红发竖立的混混。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
He was chewing on something and spat it on the ground. The big buffoon managed to intimidate me into giving him all of my Zeny!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
他嘴里嚼着什么东西，然后吐在地上。
那个大块头竟然用“抄袭”吓唬我，让我把身上的Zeny全交给他！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
This world is too
dangerous for a young
and fragile Bard.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
这个世界对年轻脆弱的诗人来说太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
By the way, Alberta doesn't seem to have changed. The Sunken Ship looks the same as well, with all of its Skeleton Pirates and whatnot. You know how it is.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
顺便说一句，艾尔贝塔似乎没什么变化。
沉船也一样，到处都是邪骸战士海盗什么的。你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
The event agency in charge of expeditions into the Sunken Ship is still making tons of money. If you have nothing to do, why don't you hunt for monsters down there?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
负责沉船探险活动的机构依然赚得盆满钵满。
如果你没事做，为什么不去下面打打魔物呢？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh, hell yes!
When is it not?
The desert is hot, has
been hot and probably
always will be...!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
噢，天哪！
什么时候不热？
沙漠很热，一直很热，可能永远都会这么热...！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Giant worms still jump out of nowhere, freaking out innocent travellers like myself, and the Sandmen still kick people in the, well... You know where.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
巨大的虫子还是会从不知哪里跳出来，吓坏像我这样无辜的旅行者，
而且沙人还是会踢人的...嗯...你知道哪里。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Even if the desert is filled with hideous monsters, the view of the ocean there is so magnificent. Hah, it makes me want to play a song.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
即使沙漠里充满了丑陋的魔物，那里的海景却非常壮丽。
哈哈，让我想弹一首曲子。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I must say there is
one place you may wish
to see in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我必须说，沙漠里有一个地方你可能想去看看。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I'm talking about the Assassin Guild. Supposedly, it's hidden behind a sandstorm in the Morocc Desert!
But you should know what I am talking about! So when are you gonna take me to the guild, eh?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我说的是刺客公会。据说它隐藏在莫洛克的沙尘暴后面！
你应该知道我在说什么吧！所以，你什么时候带我去公会看看呢？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I'm talking about the Assassin Guild. Supposedly, it's hidden behind a sandstorm in the Morocc Desert!
Have you ever been there before?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我说的是刺客公会。据说它隐藏在莫洛克的沙尘暴后面！
你以前去过那里吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Well, to the north is the Schwaltzwald Republic.
There, you'll find Juno,
the 'City of Sages.'
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
嗯，往北是施瓦茨瓦尔德共和国。
在那里，你会找到朱诺，
也就是“贤者之城”。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
The people there say that there is one major nuisance, a man known as
the 'Mad Scientist.' He's antisocial and creates a lot of public disturbances with his experiments.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
那里的人说，有一个大麻烦，一个被称为
“疯狂科学家”的男人。他性格孤僻，他的实验经常造成公共骚乱。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It seems everyone in Juno
hates him with a passion. Even one of the Tool Shop owners begged a passing adventurer to stop this Mad Scientist's research!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
看来朱诺的每个人都
非常讨厌他。甚至有一位工具店的店主
恳求路过的冒险者阻止这个疯狂科学家的研究！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But I have a different opinion about him. I believe it's not a good idea to interrupt the work of any scientist.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
但对他，我有不同的看法。我认为打断任何科学家的研究都不是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
After all, he might just discover something important, even if his experiments are a little hazardous.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
毕竟，即使他的实验有点危险，他可能也会发现一些重要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Speaking of discoveries, you know how Juno floats in the air, right?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
说到发现，你知道朱诺是漂浮在空中的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It's said that a piece of Ymir's Heart generates enough power
to keep the entire city aloft in the sky. Isn't that amazing?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
据说一块尤弥尔之心产生的能量
足以让整座城市悬浮在天空中。这不是很神奇吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Even more recent is the news about the discovery of Ymir's Book. You can read it in Juno's Sage Castle. I hear that it contains the secret to meeting Valkyrie...
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
更近的消息是关于尤弥尔之书的发现。你可以在朱诺的贤者城堡里阅读它。我听说它包含了遇见瓦尔基里的秘密...

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Huh? Okay then, talk to you later. May Bragi bless you on your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
嗯？好吧，那下次再聊。愿布拉吉保佑你的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
So, have you
met Mr. Kaili?
Please do your best.
After all, I especially
recommended you~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
那么，你
见过凯利先生了吗？
请加油。
毕竟，我特别
推荐了你哦~

scripts.text: Tell me a story.
scripts.translation: 给我讲个故事。

scripts.text: Sing a song for me.
scripts.translation: 为我唱首歌

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Hmm. What would
be a good story for
you this time...? Ah yes, I've got it. Let me tell you about one of my own adventures. It was a pretty amazing experience.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
嗯。这次给你讲个什么故事好呢...？啊，有了。让我给你讲讲我自己的冒险经历。那是一次相当惊人的体验。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I went to Morocc, the city of the desert. On my way there, I became exhausted from the heat. Luckily, I found a hole beneath the shadows and climbed in to rest.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我去了沙漠之城莫洛克。在去的路上，我热得精疲力竭。幸运的是，我在阴影下发现了一个洞，爬进去休息。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh my God...
If I had known
better, I would have
never gone inside that place...
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
天哪...
如果我知道
更多，我绝不会
进入那个地方...

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I actually crawled into the infamous ^FF0000Ant Hell^000000! I don't sound like a coward to you, do I?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我实际上爬进了臭名昭著的^FF0000蚂蚁地狱^000000！你不觉得我是个胆小鬼吧？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Well, the ants aren't the only ones living there. I wasn't afraid of them at all. Except, of course, when they attacked in groups.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
嗯，那里住着的不仅仅是蚂蚁。我一点也不怕它们。当然，除非它们成群结队地攻击。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
What I was really afraid of was this type of strawberry colored... tongue thing. Phreeoni!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我真正害怕的是这种草莓色的...舌头状的东西。皮里恩！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Fortunately, I survived the whole incident, although I still have nightmares of that man-sized tongue.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
幸运的是，我在那次事件中活了下来，尽管我仍然会梦到那个男人那么大的舌头。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Once I got out of there, I craved human companionship to restore my sense of normalcy. The closest place that I knew was Paros Lighthouse.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
从那里出来后，我渴望人类的陪伴，以恢复我的正常感。我所知道的最接近的地方是帕罗斯灯塔。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Yet again, I decided to traverse the desert, despite the fact that the Kafra Ladies provide a very convenient teleport service there.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
尽管如此，我还是决定穿越沙漠，尽管卡普拉女士们在那里提供了非常方便的传送服务。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Anyway, the fortress of Sandaruman is on the way to Paros Lighthouse. I remember Serutero, a guy I met in south Morocc, telling me about its scenic beauty.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
总之，桑达鲁曼要塞就在去帕罗斯灯塔的路上。我记得在南摩洛哥遇到的塞鲁特罗曾告诉我那里风景优美。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I was so excited
about seeing it
for myself. After all, doesn't 'Sandaruman' sound like the
name of a beautiful place?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我对自己能亲眼看到它感到兴奋。毕竟，“桑达鲁曼”听起来不像是个美丽的地方吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But I immediately regretted my decision once I arrived. Of course, the view was breathtaking: the sandy hills near the ocean, as
well as the ruins.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
但当我到达那里时，我立刻后悔了自己的决定。当然，景色令人叹为观止：海边的沙丘，以及废墟。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
And of course I forgot Serutero's warning about all the monsters. Argh! It was a nightmare! Instead of enjoying the scenary, I ended up running for my life.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
当然，我忘记了塞鲁特罗关于那里所有魔物的警告。啊！那简直是场梦魇！我没有欣赏风景，而是拼命逃命。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I was still trying to escape those monsters when I stumbled upon
an old house, West of Sandaruman, that seemed to be in a state of decay.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我还在试图逃离那些魔物时，撞上了桑达鲁曼西边的一座旧房子，看起来已经破败不堪。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I recalled that Serutero said that no one was living in that area, so I began to worry a bit. Still, I was desperate and needed refuge.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我记得塞鲁特罗说过那个地区没有人居住，所以我开始有点担心。不过，我走投无路，需要避难。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
In my panic, I violently knocked on the door and screamed for someone to let me inside. Then do you know what I heard?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
在惊慌中，我用力敲门，大喊让人让我进去。然后你猜我听到了什么？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
^FF0000Who's there?!
Who would dare to intrude
upon my territory?^000000
I was freaked out! Whoever owned that house must have been some
kind of lunatic!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
^FF0000谁在那里？！
谁敢闯入我的领地？^000000
我吓坏了！那个房子的主人一定是个疯兔！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Th-then, with the specter of Death nipping at my heels, he told me to get lost! Luckily, I was saved by a mysterious, wandering SuperNovice, but that's another story.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
然后，在死亡的阴影紧追不舍的情况下，他让我滚开！幸运的是，我被一个神秘的流浪超级新手救了，但那是另一个故事了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
In any case, I finally arrived at Paros Lighthouse. There, I learned that the old house was a secret camp for the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
无论如何，我终于到达了帕罗斯灯塔。在那里，我得知那座旧房子是流氓公会的秘密营地。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It's amazing, how they can live in such dangerous areas. Only Rogues would be able to survive there, you know?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
真不可思议，他们竟然能住在这么危险的地方。只有流氓才能在那里生存，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ah...
I'm so tired from talking so much. But if I happen to have another adventure, I shall share that tale with you.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
啊...
说了这么多，我好累。但如果我还有下一次冒险，我会把那个故事讲给你听。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ah, you wish
to hear a song?
Okay! I shall then
perform my favorite.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
啊，你想听一首歌？
好的！那我表演我最喜欢的。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I chased after fame.
It eluded me.
I ran after happiness
But never caught it.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我追逐名声。
它却离我而去。
我追逐幸福
却从未抓住它。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But tomorrow will still
Be there, I'm sure.
Like the Water Mill
In Al De Baran
Which turns as
Life goes on.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
但明天
依然会在那里，我确信。
就像艾尔帕兰的水磨坊
随着
生活的流逝
而转动。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Cheer up! Life goes on.
As surely as the Water
Mill turns, tomorrow
Will come.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
振作起来！生活还在继续。
就像水磨坊转动一样，明天
一定会到来。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Say...
Have we met before?
Hmm? Never? Well...
That's rather odd.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
说...
我们以前见过吗？
嗯？没有？那...
这有点奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I seem to recall that you've asked me to give you some information if I ever have any. Well, now I have and shall share it with you~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我似乎记得你曾让我如果有资讯就分享给你。现在我有资讯了，会分享给你~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
The usefulness of this information all depends on you. Now, have you heard of the ^3333CCMonster Research Organization^000000?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
这些资讯是否有用，全看你自己了。那么，你听说过^3333CC魔物研究组织^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I happened to get this information from its headquarters in Juno. So how does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我刚好从位于朱诺的总部得到了这些资讯。听起来怎么样？

scripts.text: Wee~ I want to hear!
scripts.translation: 哇~ 我想听！

scripts.text: Booooring~
scripts.translation: 好无聊~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Well...!
You seem to be
very excited about
this new tidbit of
knowledge I have~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
哎呀...
看来你对这个新消息
非常感兴趣呢~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Alas, this information doesn't seem to be very valuable to someone such as yourself.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
唉，看来这些资讯对你这样的人来说，并没有太大的价值。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I'm so very sorry to have excited you, but only people that are strong enough to handle grueling work can benefit from this.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
很抱歉让你兴奋了，但只有足够强大、能胜任艰巨工作的人，才能从中受益。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Why don't you travel around and gain more experiences? I will let you know when you're ready, you know~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
不如你四处旅行，多积累一些经验吧？等你准备好了，我会告诉你的~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ooh...
And you look
like you can handle
this kind of information.
I'll share everything I know!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
噢...
看来你能处理
这类资讯。
我会把我知道的都告诉你！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
One day, an adventurer discovered a strange, mysterious object. Unable to figure out what it could do, he visited the Monster Organization.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
有一天，一位冒险者发现了一个奇怪而神秘的物品。由于无法弄清它的用途，他拜访了魔物研究组织。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
There, it was entrusted to a scholar by the name of Mr. Kaili. He still hasn't uncovered the truth about that item and wishes for assistance in his investigation.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
在那里，该物品被托付给了一位名叫凯利的学者。他至今仍未揭开该物品的真相，并希望得到协助进行调查。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Mr. Kaili suspects that the item might be part of an undiscovered ancient relic. Fortunately, he is also researching ancient relics as a project assigned by the royal court.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
凯利先生怀疑该物品可能是某个未被发现的古代遗迹的一部分。幸运的是，他也正在研究古代遗迹，这是王室指派给他的项目。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
So what do you think? Isn't that interesting? Of course, you'd better speak to Mr. Kaili if you wish to learn more. If you'd like, I shall write you a letter or recommendation.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
你觉得怎么样？是不是很有趣？当然，如果你想了解更多，最好去和凯利先生对话。如果你愿意，我可以为你写一封介绍信。

scripts.text: Sure! Sounds good.
scripts.translation: 当然！听起来不错。

scripts.text: Sorry, I am not that interested.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我没那么感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Excellent...!
So your name is...
{0}?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
太好了...
那么你的名字是...
{0}？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Alright, I shall contact him right away! Oh, and you can find the Monster Organization west of Juno's central plaza. It shouldn't be hard to find. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
好的，我会立刻联系他！哦，你可以在朱诺中央广场的西侧找到魔物研究组织。应该不难找。祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ah, it's disappointing to hear that. I thought that you'd be perfect to help out Mr. Kaili. Oh well, talk to you later~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
啊，听到这话真让人失望。我以为你很适合帮助凯利先生。算了，下次再聊吧~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Boring, you say?
Perhaps, but not as
boring as an adventurer
that passes up a chance
for an adventure, yes?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
无聊，是吗？
也许吧，但这并不比
一个放弃冒险机会的冒险者
更无聊，对吧？

scripts.text: Tell me a story.
scripts.translation: 给我讲个故事。

scripts.text: Sing a song for me.
scripts.translation: 为我唱首歌

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Hmm. What would
be a good story for
you this time...? Ah yes, I've got it. Let me tell you about one of my own adventures. It was a pretty amazing experience.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
嗯。这次给你讲个什么故事好呢...？啊，有了。让我给你讲讲我自己的冒险经历。那是一次相当惊人的体验。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I went to Morocc, the city of the desert. On my way there, I became exhausted from the heat. Luckily, I found a hole beneath the shadows and climbed in to rest.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我去了沙漠之城莫洛克。在去的路上，我热得精疲力竭。幸运的是，我在阴影下发现了一个洞，爬进去休息。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh my God...
If I had known
better, I never
would have gone
inside that place...
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
天哪...
如果我知道
后果，我绝不会
进入那个地方...

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I actually crawled into the infamous ^FF0000Ant Hell^000000! I don't sound like a coward to you, do I?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我实际上爬进了臭名昭著的^FF0000蚂蚁地狱^000000！你不觉得我是个胆小鬼吧？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Well, the ants aren't the only ones living there. I wasn't afraid of them at all. Except, of course, when they attacked in groups.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
嗯，那里住着的不仅仅是蚂蚁。我一点也不怕它们。当然，除非它们成群结队地攻击。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
What I was really afraid of was this type of strawberry colored... tongue thing. Phreeoni!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我真正害怕的是这种草莓色的...舌头状的东西。皮里恩！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Fortunately, I survived the whole incident, although I still have nightmares of that man-sized tongue.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
幸运的是，我在那次事件中活了下来，尽管我仍然会梦到那个男人那么大的舌头。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Once I got out of there, I craved human companionship to restore my sense of normalcy. The closest place that I knew was Paros Lighthouse.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
从那里出来后，我渴望人类的陪伴，以恢复我的正常感。我所知道的最接近的地方是帕罗斯灯塔。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Yet again, I decided to traverse the desert, despite the fact that the Kafra Ladies provide a very convenient teleport service there.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
尽管如此，我还是决定穿越沙漠，尽管卡普拉女士们在那里提供了非常方便的传送服务。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Anyway, the fortress of Sandaruman is on the way to Paros Lighthouse. I remember Serutero, a guy I met in south Morocc, telling me about its scenic beauty.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
总之，桑达鲁曼要塞就在去帕罗斯灯塔的路上。我记得在南摩洛哥遇到的塞鲁特罗曾告诉我那里风景优美。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I was so excited
about seeing it
for myself. After all, doesn't 'Sandaruman' sound like the
name of a beautiful place?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我对自己能亲眼看到它感到兴奋。毕竟，“桑达鲁曼”听起来不像是个美丽的地方吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But I immediately regretted my decision once I arrived. Of course, the view was breathtaking: the sandy hills near the ocean, as
well as the ruins.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
但当我到达那里时，我立刻后悔了自己的决定。当然，景色令人叹为观止：海边的沙丘，以及废墟。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
And of course I forgot Serutero's warning about all the monsters. Argh! It was a nightmare! Instead of enjoying the scenary, I ended up running for my life.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
当然，我忘记了塞鲁特罗关于那里所有魔物的警告。啊！那简直是场梦魇！我没有欣赏风景，而是拼命逃命。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I was still trying to escape those monsters when I stumbled upon
an old house, West of Sandaruman, that seemed to be in a state of decay.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我还在试图逃离那些魔物时，撞上了桑达鲁曼西边的一座旧房子，看起来已经破败不堪。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I recalled that Serutero said that no one was living in that area, so I began to worry a bit. Still, I was desperate and needed refuge.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我记得塞鲁特罗说过那个地区没有人居住，所以我开始有点担心。不过，我走投无路，需要避难。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
In my panic, I violently knocked on the door and screamed for someone to let me inside. Then do you know what I heard?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
在惊慌中，我用力敲门，大喊让人让我进去。然后你猜我听到了什么？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
^FF0000Who's there?!
Who would dare to intrude
upon my territory?^000000
I was freaked out! Whoever owned that house must have been some
kind of lunatic!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
^FF0000谁在那里？！
谁敢闯入我的领地？^000000
我吓坏了！那个房子的主人一定是个疯兔！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Th-then, with the specter of Death nipping at my heels, he told me to get lost! Luckily, I was saved by a mysterious, wandering SuperNovice, but that's another story.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
然后，在死亡的阴影紧追不舍的情况下，他让我滚开！幸运的是，我被一个神秘的流浪超级新手救了，但那是另一个故事了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
In any case, I finally arrived at Paros Lighthouse. There, I learned that the old house was a secret camp for the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
无论如何，我终于到达了帕罗斯灯塔。在那里，我得知那座旧房子是流氓公会的秘密营地。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It's amazing, how they can live in such dangerous areas. Only Rogues would be able to survive there, you know?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
真不可思议，他们竟然能住在这么危险的地方。只有流氓才能在那里生存，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ah...
I'm so tired from talking so much. But if I happen to have another adventure, I shall share that tale with you.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
啊...
说了这么多，我好累。但如果我还有下一次冒险，我会把那个故事讲给你听。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ah, you wish
to hear a song?
Okay! I shall then
perform my favorite.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
啊，你想听一首歌？
好的！那我表演我最喜欢的。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I chased after fame.
It eluded me.
I ran after happiness
But never caught it.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我追逐名声。
它却离我而去。
我追逐幸福
却从未抓住它。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But tomorrow will still
Be there, I'm sure.
Like the Water Mill
In Al De Baran
Which turns as
Life goes on.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
但明天
依然会在那里，我确信。
就像艾尔帕兰的水磨坊
随着
生活的流逝
而转动。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Cheer up! Life goes on.
As surely as the Water
Mill turns, tomorrow
Will come.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
振作起来！生活还在继续。
就像水磨坊转动一样，明天
一定会到来。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Hello there!
Isn't it such
a glorious day?
You know of me,
do you not?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
你好呀！
今天真是个好天气呢！
你认识我，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Hahahaha, forgive my rudeness,
but I fail to remember your name, although your face does seem rather familiar.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
哈哈哈哈哈，抱歉失礼了，
虽然你的脸看起来很熟悉，但我实在想不起你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh well well...
How could I ever
forget the lovely
{0}?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
哎呀哎呀...
我怎么可能
忘记可爱的
{0}呢？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
So, aren't you curious about me? Feel free to ask me whatever you like! I'm the vagabond that will wander the earth till the end of his days, your friend who loves to sing under the moonlight~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
那么，你不好奇我吗？尽管问吧！我是那个将流浪至生命尽头的流浪者，也是喜欢在月光下歌唱的朋友~

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: What's new?
scripts.translation: 有什么新鲜事？

scripts.text: Can you sing?
scripts.translation: 你会唱歌吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Why, I am Nelliorde, the Bard.
In truth, my real name is Elliorde.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我是内利奥德，一名诗人。
其实，我的本名叫艾利奥德。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
However, while I was singing at a Tavern, as per usual, a man with long blonde hair angrily demanded that I change my name!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
然而，有一次我在酒馆唱歌时，一个金发男子愤怒地要求我改名！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Never before have I seen such a flailing and a fuss over someone coincidentally sharing the same name!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我从未见过有人因为名字巧合而如此大动干戈！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
And so, that little altercation
was settled with me being named Nelliorde.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
于是，那场小争执
以我被改名为内利奥德而告终。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I don't sound like a coward to you, do I? Do you believe I should have fought for the right to keep my original name?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
你觉得我是个胆小鬼吗？你认为我应该为保留原名而战吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
If so, you're wrong! I just don't believe that violence can solve anything, as the romantic Bard
that cherishes peace...
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
如果是这样，那你就错了！作为一个珍视和平的浪漫诗人，我不相信暴力能解决任何问题...

scripts.text:
^3355FFSeeing as it's not worth
listening to Nelliorde's lies, you decide to simply tune him out.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF既然听内利奥德撒谎毫无意义，你决定直接无视他。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
And that's how I convinced wise
and benevolent King Tristram III to build a paradise where married lovers could enjo--Hm? Are you even listening?!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
就这样，我成功说服了睿智仁慈的国王特里斯坦三世，建造了一个让已婚恋人能尽情享--嗯？你在听吗？！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
You wish to
hear of some news?
What kind of news do
you wish to know about?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
你想听
什么新闻？
你想了解
哪方面的消息？

scripts.text: About Prontera!
scripts.translation: 关于普隆德拉！

scripts.text: About seaside areas.
scripts.translation: 关于海边地区。

scripts.text: Is the desert still hot?
scripts.translation: 沙漠还是很热吗？

scripts.text: How about the borderlands?
scripts.translation: 边境地区怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
What?! Prontera?!
Can you not see that the front
gate of Prontera is right before you? You should at least know where you are, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
什么？！普隆德拉？！
你没看到普隆德拉的正门就在你面前吗？
冒险者，你至少该知道自己在哪吧。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Anyways, I know one interesting bit of news about Prontera. But it's a secret. Shh! Are you... Single?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
总之，我知道一条关于普隆德拉的有趣新闻。但是这是秘密。嘘！你是...单身吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
If so, go visit the tavern. I met a guy there who took me a nice place. Oh yes. He took me the place where singles are forbidden~!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
如果是的话，去酒馆看看吧。我在那里遇到一个家伙，他带我去了一家不错的店。哦对了。他带我去了一家禁止单身者进入的地方~！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Seaside areas?
That's a funny question. I mean, there's Alberta and a few other places where you can see the sea.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
海边地区？
真是有趣的问题。我是说，艾尔贝塔和其他几个地方都能看到大海。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
To the southwest there's
Kokomo Beach. But, I suppose it's too dangerous just to go there to take a stroll.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
西南方有克克魔海边。
不过，我觉得光是去那里散步就太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Kokomo Beach is a large
expanse of sand. The nearby water is filled with sea animals, so you can enjoy catching Shellfishes.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
克克魔海边是一大片沙滩。
附近的水域里充满了海洋生物，所以你可以尽情捕捉贝类。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
However, there are always bullies in that kind of place. Once, I met a threatening looking hoodlum with red spiky hair.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
不过，那种地方总是会有恶霸。
有一次，我遇到了一个长相凶恶、红发竖立的混混。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
He was chewing on something and spat on the ground. The big buffoon managed to intimidate me into giving him all of my Zeny!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
他嘴里嚼着什么东西，然后吐在地上。那个大笨蛋竟然用恐吓的手段，让我把身上的Zeny全交给了他！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
This world is too
dangerous for a young
and fragile Bard.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
这个世界对年轻脆弱的诗人来说太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
By the way, Alberta doesn't seem to have changed. The Sunken Ship looks the same as well, with all of its Skeleton Pirates and whatnot. You know how it is.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
顺便说一句，艾尔贝塔似乎没什么变化。
沉船也一样，到处都是邪骸战士海盗什么的。你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
The event agency in charge of expeditions into the Sunken Ship is still making tons of money. If you have nothing to do, why don't you hunt for monsters down there?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
负责沉船探险活动的机构依然赚得盆满钵满。
如果你没事做，为什么不去下面打打魔物呢？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh yes!
When is it not?
The desert is hot, has
been hot and probably
always will be...!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
哦，是的！
什么时候不热呢？
沙漠很热，一直都很热，
而且大概永远都会这么热...！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Giant worms still jump out of nowhere, freaking out innocent travellers like myself, and the Sandmen still kick people in the, well... You know where.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
巨大的虫子还是会从不知哪里跳出来，吓坏像我这样无辜的旅行者，
而且沙人还是会踢人的...嗯...你知道哪里。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Even if the desert is filled with hideous monsters, the view of the ocean there is so magnificent. Hah, it makes me want to play a song.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
即使沙漠里充满了丑陋的魔物，那里的海景却非常壮丽。
哈哈，让我想弹一首曲子。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I must say there is
one place you may wish
to see in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我必须说，沙漠里有一个地方你可能想去看看。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I'm talking about the Assassin Guild. Supposedly, it's hidden behind a sandstorm in the Morocc
Desert! But you should know what I am talking about! So when are you gonna take me to the guild, eh?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我说的是刺客公会。据说它隐藏在摩洛哥沙漠的沙暴之后！不过你应该知道我在说什么吧！所以，你什么时候带我去公会啊，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I'm talking about the Assassin Guild. Supposedly, it's hidden behind a sandstorm in the Morocc
Desert! Have you ever been there before?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
我说的是刺客公会。据说它隐藏在摩洛哥沙漠的沙暴之后！你以前去过那里吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Well, to the north is the Schwaltzwald Republic.
There, you'll find Juno,
the 'City of Sages.'
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
嗯，往北是施瓦茨瓦尔德共和国。
在那里，你会找到朱诺，
也就是“贤者之城”。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
The people there say that there is one major nuisance, a man known
as the 'Mad Scientist.' He's antisocial and creates a lot of public disturbances with his experiments.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
那里的人说，有一个主要的麻烦人物，被称为“疯狂科学家”。他性格孤僻，经常因为他的实验引起公共骚乱。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It seems everyone in Juno hates
him with a passion. Even one of the Tool Shop owners begged a passing adventurer to stop this Mad Scientist's research!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
看来朱诺的每个人都对他恨之入骨。甚至有一位工具店的店主都恳求路过的冒险者去阻止这位疯狂科学家的研究！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But I have a different opinion about him. I believe it's not a good idea to interrupt the work of any scientist.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
但对他，我有不同的看法。我认为打断任何科学家的研究都不是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
After all, he might just discover something important, even if his experiments are a little hazardous.
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
毕竟，即使他的实验有点危险，他可能也会发现一些重要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Speaking of discoveries, you know how Juno floats in the air, right?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
说到发现，你知道朱诺是漂浮在空中的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It's said that a piece of Ymir's Heart generates enough power
to keep the entire city aloft in the sky. Isn't that amazing?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
据说一块尤弥尔之心产生的能量
足以让整座城市悬浮在天空中。这不是很神奇吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Even more recent is the news about the discovery of Ymir's Book. You can read it in Juno's Sage Castle. I hear that it contains the secret to meeting Valkyrie...
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
更近的消息是关于尤弥尔之书的发现。你可以在朱诺的贤者城堡里阅读它。我听说它包含了遇见瓦尔基里的秘密...

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Can I sing, you ask?
Certainly, and if I may say so, pleasureably. Which song would
you care to hear?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
你想问我能不能唱歌吗？
当然可以，而且如果我不自夸的话，唱得还挺悦耳的。你想听哪首歌呢？

scripts.text: Bragi's Poem
scripts.translation: 布拉吉的诗篇

scripts.text: Eternal Chaos
scripts.translation: 永恒的混沌

scripts.text: Assassin in the Sunset
scripts.translation: 夕阳下的刺客

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Bragi's Poem!
What a good choice!
I must say this song
represents the
heart of a poet!
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
布拉吉的诗篇！
真是好选择！
不得不说，这首歌
代表了
诗人的心！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Please forgive me, but I cannot play a song for free. The world is harsh, and a frail Bard such as myself must have some means
to survive~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
请原谅我，但我不能免费演奏。世界很残酷，像我这样瘦弱的诗人必须得找点办法生存下去~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
You must like robust
and energetic music, eh?
As you wish~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
看来你喜欢强劲而充满活力的音乐，是吗？
如你所愿~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Please forgive me, but I cannot play a song for free. The world is harsh, and a frail Bard such as myself must have some means
to survive~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
请原谅我，但我不能免费演奏。世界很残酷，像我这样瘦弱的诗人必须得找点办法生存下去~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Excellent choice!
Somehow, the image of
the setting sun fits
well with Assassins.
Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
极好的选择！
不知为何，夕阳西下的景象
与刺客很相配。
你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Please forgive me, but I cannot play a song for free. The world is harsh, and a frail Bard such as myself must have some means
to survive~
scripts.translation:
[内利奥德]
请原谅我，但我不能免费演奏。世界很残酷，像我这样瘦弱的诗人必须得找点办法生存下去~

scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您现在携带的物品太多了。请先将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Studying Scholar]
Hmmm...
The highest quality Red Potion ever...
scripts.translation:
[研读中的学者]
嗯...
史上最高品质的红色药水...

scripts.text:
[Studying Scholar]
If only I could figure a way to balance the consistency of the ground Red Herbs mixed with the water. That part is most crucial...
scripts.translation:
[研读中的学者]
要是我能找到一种方法，平衡地面上的红色药草与水的混合比例就好了。那部分是最关键的...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Ah, {0},
you've returned.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
啊，{0}，
你回来了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Learning about Brisingamen was truly fascinating. But since we've hit a plateau for now, I've started a new research project.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
研究女神项链真的非常迷人。但既然我们现在遇到了瓶颈，我就开始了一个新的研究项目。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hahahaha~
I'm sorry, but I cannot tell you about it for now, since it's confidential. But once I get a chance, I'll ask you for help.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
哈哈哈~
抱歉，现在还不能告诉你，因为这是机密。但一旦有机会，我会请你帮忙的。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Ah, I see. So it's true that Berling sealed himself in the ripple where the goddess' tear
fell into the waters.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
啊，我明白了。所以是真的，贝林将自己封印在女神之泪落入水中的涟漪之中。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Oh! I'm so excited! I don't know what to do first! Should I report to His Majesty or publish my findings or...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
哦！我太激动了！我不知道该先做什么！是向陛下汇报，还是发表我的研究成果，还是...

scripts.text: ^333333*Ahem!*^000000 My reward!

[Enrico Kaili]
Oh, right.
Thank you for all the trouble you have endured for my sake. You are truly one of the best researchers I've ever met.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
哦，对了。
谢谢你为我承受了这么多麻烦。你是我见过的最优秀的研究员之一。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Then as promised...
I will give you something from my precious collection! Now, let me see what we have here...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
那么，按照约定...
我会从我的珍藏中拿出一样东西给你！让我看看这里有什么...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Please...
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
请...
收下这个。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Please accept this as my way of thanking you for assisting in my
research. If the opportunity arises, I would like to ask you for your help once again. Now please, take care.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
请收下这个，以感谢你在我的研究中提供的帮助。如果有机会，我还想再次请求你的帮助。那么，请保重。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Why are you still here?
I asked you to go find Alfrik.
Ah~ I cannot wait...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
你为什么还在这里？
我让你去找阿尔弗里克。
啊~我迫不及待了...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I guess it's true that
the four Dwarves have been
awakened. Does this mean that Brisingamen can now be created?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
看来是真的，
四位矮人已经苏醒了。这意味着现在可以制作女神项链了吗？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
If such a thing is possible, what do we need in order to create it? Let's review the information you've gathered...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
如果这是可能的，我们需要什么才能制作它？让我们回顾一下你收集到的信息...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
There's Freya's Tear Drop Crystal, Freya's Jewel, the Never-Melting Snow Crystal found where Alfrik
used to stay, the Drifting Air from the path where Dvalin slept. Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
有菲力亚的掉落眼泪、菲力亚宝石、在阿尔弗里克曾居住之地找到的雪的结晶，以及德瓦林沉睡之路上的空气雕像。嗯。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Perhaps we could find something from the pond of Freya's Gold Tears where Berling is sleeping,
though I am unsure.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
也许我们可以在贝林沉睡的菲力亚金泪之池中找点什么，
虽然我不确定。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I also assume that the splendid Silver Ornament constructed by
Gher is also needed to create Brisingamen.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我也假设，由格雷尔制作的华丽银饰品也是制作女神项链所必需的。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
So what
do you think?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
那么，
你怎么看？

scripts.text: I'm not sure...
scripts.translation: 我不确定...

scripts.text: I suppose you're right.
scripts.translation: 我想你说得对。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not sure...
I mean, maybe
Alfrik would
probably know, bu--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不确定...
我是说，也许
阿尔弗里克
会知道，但--

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Of course!
That's a great idea! I'll wait here while you go and ask Alfrik. You're my only hope in completing this research!
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
当然！
这是个好主意！我会在这里等你，你去问问阿尔弗里克。你是我完成这项研究的唯一希望！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333I shouldn't have said anything...^000000)

[Enrico Kaili]
Well, what are
waiting for? Please
come back as soon
as possible.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
好了，你还在
等什么？请尽快
回来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I suppose
you're right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想
你说得对。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Still, who knows what exactly is in the Pond of Freya's Golden Tears.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过，谁知道菲力亚金泪之池中到底有什么。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Yes.
Ah! Right.
Hm, perhaps it would be
best to ask Alfrik first?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
是的。
啊！对了。
嗯，也许最好先问问阿尔弗里克？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hurry and seek him
out! And I thank you
in advance.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
快去找到他！
我提前谢谢你了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I guess he finally sang for you?
By the way, why didn't you speak to Grer the Dwarf? Oh right, the mine is heavily populated with monsters.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
看来他终于为你唱了？
顺便问一下，你为什么没有和矮人格雷尔对话？哦对了，矿洞里魔物很多。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I know it won't be easy,
but please seek him out
and get more information.
Thank you in advance.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我知道这不容易，
但还是请你去找他，
获取更多信息。
提前谢谢你了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hm...?
Did you forget the words to the song? Well, I didn't write them down either. Hahahaha! I guess there's only one thing you can do~
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
嗯...？
你忘了那首歌的歌词吗？
其实我也没记下来。哈哈！
看来你只能做一件事了~

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
You've got to go back to Berling and ask him for the lyrics again. Good luck, and don't forget to memorize them this time.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
你得回去找贝林，
让他再告诉你一次歌词。
祝你好运，
这次可别忘了记下来。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
It looks like you were able to answer that riddle. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
看来你成功解开了那个谜题。
干得不错！

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
That strange, unearthly feeling of dampness... Ah, you've brought Freya's Tear Drops! That means Grer must have awakened on his own now.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
那种奇怪、非自然的潮湿感...
啊，你带来了菲力亚的掉落眼泪！
这意味着格雷尔应该已经自行苏醒了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I suppose your next course of action should be to enter the mine. I'm sorry for the trouble, but I grow more excited with each new thing we learn.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我想你接下来的行动应该是进入矿洞。
抱歉给你添麻烦了，
但随着我们了解到更多新事物，
我变得越来越兴奋了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
It's only with your help that I've been able to make such progress with my research. Anyway, I shall share my conclusions with you later.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
多亏了你的帮助，
我的研究才能取得如此进展。
总之，稍后我会把我的结论分享给你。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
So are you heading for the mine now? Be careful around those monsters.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
那么你现在要前往矿洞了吗？
小心那些魔物。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Dvalin's riddle?
He must have been
talking about the
endless war that
Freya had to cause.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
德瓦林的谜题？
他一定是在说
菲力亚不得不引发的
那场无尽的战争。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
There were two kings that
each had twenty knights. The kings and these knights fought and killed each other, and would be brought back to life the next morning by Freya until thousands of Valkyries filled Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
有两位国王，
各自拥有二十名骑士。
国王们和这些骑士互相厮杀，
并在第二天清晨被菲力亚复活，
直到数千名瓦尔基里填满了瓦尔哈拉。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
All forty-two
of them did this...
Everyday. It's an old
story that everyone knows.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
这四十二个人
每天都这样做...
这是一个
众所周知的古老故事。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
In any case, it's about time that you investigated Berling. There's
a stream that begins northwest of Prontera and passes through a mine in Mount Mjolnir.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
总之，是时候去调查贝林了。
有一条溪流从普隆德拉的西北方发源，
流经雷神之锤山的一座矿洞。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
It may be wise to
start your search there and investigate any streams and
puddles that you can find.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
也许从那里开始搜索，
并调查你能找到的
任何溪流和水坑
会比较明智。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Are you sure?!
Those items were
intended to create
Freya's necklace,
Brisingamen?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
你确定吗？！
那些物品
是为了制作
菲力亚的女神项链，
即布里斯加曼？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
If the four Dwarves
awaken, Brisingamen may
appear before human eyes?
Fascinating. Just fascinating.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
如果四位矮人苏醒，
布里斯加曼
可能会出现在人类眼前？
太迷人了。
真是迷人极了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Let's see....
The place where
Dvalin is sleeping?
I assume it may be near
the place where the Monks
train, but I am unsure.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
让我想想....
德瓦林沉睡的地方？
我假设它可能在
武僧训练的地方附近，
但我不确定。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
In any case, it would
to no harm to investigate
any leads yes? The monastery,
I believe, is to the east
of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
总之，调查一下
这些线索也无妨，对吧？
修道院，
我相信在普隆德拉的东边。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
What...?
You actually
met Alfrik...?
I can't believe
the legendary Alfrick
is still alive...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
什么...？
你真的见到了阿尔弗里克...？
我不敢相信
传说中的阿尔弗里克
还活着...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Alfrik is one of the four Dwarves who created Brisingamen, the world's most beautiful necklace, for the goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
阿尔弗里克是四位矮人之一，
他们为女神菲力亚
制作了世界上最美丽的项链，
布里斯加曼。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Now I realize...
We've been gathering information related to an item containing the power of the gods!
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
现在我明白了...
我们一直在收集
与一件蕴含神力物品相关的信息！

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Let's see...
There's another Dwarf, Dvalin.
Did Alfrik tell you anything about where Dvalin may be sleeping? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
让我想想...
还有一位矮人，德瓦林。
阿尔弗里克有没有告诉你
德瓦林可能在哪儿沉睡？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
For now, I suppose
it would be best to
investigate Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
目前，我觉得
最好先去调查一下姜饼城。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Somewhere there, I'm
sure you can find a remaining trace of the goddess Freya. If you were able to meet Valkyrie, I'm sure you'll be able to do this.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
在那里的某个地方，
我相信你一定能找到
女神菲力亚留下的痕迹。
既然你能见到瓦尔基里，
我相信你一定能做到。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I've been thinking...
About those words
Valkyrie told you
to remember...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我一直在想...
瓦尔基里让你记住的
那些话...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
^4d4dffThe beauty of the stars
Wanes in comparison.
We lost our hearts
To that golden hair
And those dazzling eyes.^000000
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
^4d4dff星光之美
相比之下黯然失色。
我们的心
迷失在那金色的头发
和那双耀眼的眼睛中。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
What could that mean?
I'm beginning to doubt
what I think I know...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
那是什么意思？
我开始怀疑
我所知道的一切了...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I can tell you've
gone through a lot...
So what did you hear
from Hermite?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
看得出你经历了很多...
那么，你在隐士那里
听到了什么？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Enrico Kaili
what you were told by Hermite,
as well as your experiences
with Valkyrie.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF告诉恩里科·凯利
隐士告诉你的话，
以及你与瓦尔基里的经历。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I can scarcely believe this!
But if what you say is true, it may be possible for humans to possess godly power.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我简直不敢相信！
但如果你说的是真的，
人类或许也能拥有神力。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hm? There's a reaction coming
from this thing that was sent from the royal court. Hm, come closer and take a look.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
嗯？
这个从王宫送来的东西
有反应。嗯，靠近点看看。

scripts.text: ^3355FFEnrico opened a locked chest, revealing an incredibly clear, shimmering jewel.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF恩里科打开了一个上锁的箱子，
里面有一颗极其清澈、闪闪发光的宝石。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Isn't it amazing?
If what Valkyrie said is true, this jewel must be a crystal from Freya's teardrop.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
是不是很神奇？
如果瓦尔基里说的是真的，
这颗宝石一定是
菲力亚泪滴中的水晶。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I don't understand why all of this is happening so suddenly. For now, I'll have to think about the poem you heard from Valkyrie.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我不明白为什么这一切
发生得这么突然。
目前，我得好好想想
你从瓦尔基里那里听到的诗篇。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
A cold snowy path on
which the goddess tread.
A blue river the goddess crossed.
A narrow path the goddess passed.
Four Dwarves that the goddess met...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
一条女神踏过的
冰冷雪路。
一条女神渡过的蓝色河流。
一条女神经过的狭窄小径。
四位女神遇见的矮人...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I'm sure the four Dwarves are the famous craftsmen I've studied, but I can't determine what the rest of the poem means.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我确信那四位矮人
就是我研究过的那些著名工匠，
但我无法确定
诗篇其余部分的意思。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Now...
I'll need your
help once again!
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
现在...
我又需要
你的帮助了！

scripts.text: Wah? It's not over?!
scripts.translation: 哇？还没结束？！

scripts.text: What is it this time?
scripts.translation: 这次又是什么？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hah...!
Our work has just begun!
Now, head over to Lutie
and find some clues.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
哈...！
我们的工作才刚刚开始！
现在，去姜饼城
寻找一些线索。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
The poem mentions a snowy path, and this jewel was found there, so Lutie is a pretty well educated guess as the location of our next clue.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
诗篇提到了雪路，
而这颗宝石就是在那里找到的，
所以姜饼城
很可能是我们下一个线索的所在地。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I hope we'll be
able to learn what
the goddess Freya has
left behind in Midgard...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
希望我们能
弄清楚女神芙蕾雅
在米德加尔特
留下了什么...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hahahaha...!
I like your attitute!
Once again, Nelliorde has
proven to be an excellent
judge of character.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
哈哈哈哈哈...！
我喜欢你的态度！
内利奥德
再次证明了他
是识人的行家。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
The poem mentions
a snowy path, and this jewel was found in Lutie. So Lutie would be a pretty good place to search for the next clue.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
诗篇提到了雪路，
而这颗宝石是在姜饼城找到的。
所以姜饼城
很可能是寻找下一个线索的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I hope we'll be
able to learn what
the goddess Freya has
left behind in Midgard...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
希望我们能
弄清楚女神芙蕾雅
在米德加尔特
留下了什么...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hmm...?
I see...
I know the work
I'm having you do might
be quite troublesome...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
嗯...？
我明白了...
我知道让你做的这些工作
可能有点麻烦...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
But rest assured,
I will reward you
once our work is completed.
Good help such as the kind
you provide is hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
但请放心，
等我们的工作完成后，
我会好好报答你的。
像你这样的好帮手
可是很难找的。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
So have you
met Hermite? Hm?
He actually asked
you to do that?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
那么，你
见过隐士了吗？嗯？
他居然让你
去做那个？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
For now, it looks like you might have no alternative. It would probably be wise to do what he wants. Knowing Charles, it's probably won't be too bad.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
目前看来，你似乎别无选择。最好还是照他说的做吧。以查尔斯的性格，应该不会太糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hermite...?
Do you need more
information about him?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
隐士...？
你需要更多关于他的
信息吗？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Oh, that's right!
He's a registered member of that Monster Research Organization. Why don't you ask the lady over there for more information on him?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
哦，对了！
他是那个魔物研究组织的注册成员。你不妨去问问那边那位女士，了解更多关于他的信息？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
If she'll let you look at her records, you can probably find out where he lives. Now why don't you talk to that lady towards the left part of this room?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
如果她允许你查阅记录，你大概能查出他住在哪里。现在，你不妨去和这个房间左边的那位女士谈谈？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
So, have you
considered my proposal?
Work for me, and I shall
surely repay you.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
那么，你
考虑过我的提议了吗？
为我工作，我保证
会好好报答你的。

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Sure, why not.
scripts.translation: 当然，为什么不呢。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
What...?!
Then why bother
to speak to me?
If you just intend to
bother me, then please
leave right away.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
什...么？！
那你为什么还要
来和我对话？
如果你只是想
打扰我，那就请
立刻离开。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Really?
If you could help me, that would be great! Before we start, would you take a look at this?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
真的吗？
如果你能帮我，那就太好了！在开始之前，你能看一下这个吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFEnrico Kaili showed you a small white crystallization inside a box. It looked very fragile, but emanated an intensely
cold aura.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF恩里科·凯利给你看了一个盒子里的白色小结晶。它看起来非常脆弱，但散发着强烈的寒气。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I call this the Snow Crystal.
It looks just like a snowflake, doesn't it? Strangely enough,
it's never melted.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我称它为雪的结晶。
它看起来就像雪花，不是吗？奇怪的是，
它从未融化过。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
A few years ago,
a young adventurer
gave this to me. I need to find this person so that I can find out exactly what this is, as well as where it came from.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
几年前，
一位年轻的冒险者
把它给了我。我需要找到这个人，
以便弄清楚这到底是什么，以及它来自哪里。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Now, the person
who brought this to
me is, let's see, ah...
Hermite Charles.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
现在，把这件东西
带给我的人，让我想想，啊...
是隐士 查尔斯。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
When you find him,
please give him this letter.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
找到他之后，
请把这封信交给他。

scripts.text:
^3355FFEnrico gave you a small
letter addressed to Hermite
Charles that is sealed with
red wax.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF恩里科给你了一封写给隐士 查尔斯的小信，上面封着红色的蜡封。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Ah, you've arrived!
{0}, right?
Yes, I was told by Nelliorde that you'd come. He always manages
to find me good, reliable help.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
啊，你来了！
{0}，对吧？
内利奥德告诉我你会来。他总是能帮我找到可靠的好帮手。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
As Nelliorde probably mentioned,
I need some help in completing my research. Since you adventurers are always traveling, I was hoping you'd help me find someone.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
内利奥德可能已经提过了，
我需要一些帮助来完成我的研究。既然你们冒险者总是四处旅行，我希望你能帮我找一个人。

scripts.text: I'm no good at finding people.
scripts.translation: 我不擅长找人。

scripts.text: I can do that!
scripts.translation: 我可以做到！

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Oh... Really?
I was really hoping that you'd be able to help me. But I understand if it's not within your capacity.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
哦...是吗？
我真的很希望你能帮帮我。不过，如果这超出了你的能力范围，我也能理解。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I suppose I can try to find another adventurer to help me. But if you change your mind later, please do not hesitate to lend me your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我想我可以试着找另一位冒险者来帮忙。但如果你之后改变主意了，请随时伸出援手。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Really?
If you could help me, that would be great! Before we start, would you take a look at this?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
真的吗？
如果你能帮我，那就太好了！在开始之前，你能看一下这个吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFEnrico Kaili showed you a small white crystallization inside a box. It looked very fragile, but emanated an intensely
cold aura.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF恩里科·凯利给你看了一个盒子里的白色小结晶。它看起来非常脆弱，但散发着强烈的寒气。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I call this the Snow Crystal.
It looks just like a snowflake, doesn't it? Strangely enough,
it's never melted.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我称它为雪的结晶。
它看起来就像雪花，不是吗？奇怪的是，
它从未融化过。

scripts.text:

A few years ago,
a young adventurer
gave this to me. I need to find this person so that I can find out exactly what this is, as well as where it came from.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
几年前，
一位年轻的冒险者
把它给了我。我需要找到这个人，
以便弄清楚这到底是什么，以及它来自哪里。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Now, the person
who brought this to
me is, let's see, ah...
Hermite Charles.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
现在，把这件东西
带给我的人，让我想想，啊...
是隐士 查尔斯。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
When you find him,
please give him this letter.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
找到他之后，
请把这封信交给他。

scripts.text:
^3355FFEnrico gave you a small
letter addressed to Hermite
Charles that is sealed with
red wax.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF恩里科给你了一封写给隐士 查尔斯的小信，上面封着红色的蜡封。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I'm not exactly sure why you've come to me, but I apologize for the fact that I'm unable to help you.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
我不太确定你为什么来找我，但很抱歉，我目前无法帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Right now, I'm far
too busy trying to
complete my research.
Please leave me alone
to do my work.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凯利]
现在，我正忙着
完成我的研究。
请让我一个人
专心工作。

scripts.text:
[Studying Scholar]
Do you know how
to make Red Potions?
You grind a lot of Red Herbs and carefully shake the liquid until you achieve the desire consistency.
scripts.translation:
[研读中的学者]
你知道怎么做红色药水吗？
你需要研磨大量的红色药草，然后小心地摇晃液体，直到达到理想的浓度。

scripts.text:
[Studying Scholar]
If I could find a way
to produce them much faster,
I'd become rich in no time...
scripts.translation:
[研读中的学者]
如果我能找到一种
更快的生产方法，
我很快就会变得富有...

scripts.text:
[Praying Man]
Let everyone live a life
of happiness. Let there be
peace in the world...
scripts.translation:
[祈祷的男子]
愿众生幸福。
愿世界和平...

scripts.text:
[Praying Man]
May I hit it rich with this
Old Blue Box that I spend this
month's paycheck on...
scripts.translation:
[祈祷的男子]
愿我用这个月工资买的
神秘箱子
能让我发大财...

scripts.text:
[Praying Man]
Now is the time to reflect upon the past to prepare for the future.
scripts.translation:
[祈祷的男子]
现在是反思过去，为未来做准备的时候了。

scripts.text:
[Praying Man]
It is in stillness that we find the wisdom to know which steps we must take to move forward. Let's pray.
scripts.translation:
[祈祷的男子]
在宁静中，我们才能找到智慧，知道该迈出哪一步才能前进。让我们祈祷吧。

scripts.text: ^3355FFHermite Charles continues to fervently pray. His eyes are closed and his hands are clasped to his chest. There seems to be an air of faint sadness about him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF隐士 查尔斯仍在 fervently 祈祷。他闭着眼睛，双手合十放在胸前。他身上似乎笼罩着一层淡淡的悲伤。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
What did you just say?
Did she really become an
Einherjar? That's the greatest honor for any warrior...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
你刚才说什么？
她真的成为了英灵战士？那是任何战士至高无上的荣耀...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
She must
be so happy.
I guess in the end,
I never really had
any place in her heart.
Lowen...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
她一定
很幸福吧。
我想，到头来，
我在她心中
并没有真正的位置。
洛温...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
But I know one thing
for sure. She should have blamed me for what happened. Why did she take everything upon herself?
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
但有一件事我很确定。她本该责怪我的。为什么她要独自承担一切？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I guess she just saw me as a little brother. She obviously didn't take me very seriously.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我想她只是把我当作弟弟。她显然没有很认真地对待我。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Haha... Hahaha...
Now I feel better!
So, what did you say?
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
哈哈...哈哈哈...
现在我感觉好多了！
那么，你刚才说什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Yes, right.
Please tell Enrico this.
The object he's interested in was given by His Majesty to a guild that possessed a castle.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
是的，没错。
请告诉恩里科这件事。
他感兴趣的那个物品，是陛下赐予拥有城堡的公会的。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
It can never be made through just human technology. But I guess that His Majesty will let scholars study it and let men possess it if they prove capable.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
它绝非仅凭人类科技所能制造。不过我想，陛下会让学者们研究它，并允许证明自己有资格的人拥有它。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I wasn't powerful enough to
earn it. Frankly, I stole it. But soon I began to fear its presense and my heart would pound with trepidation when I saw it.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我当时实力不够，无法获得它。说实话，我是偷来的。但很快我就开始害怕它的存在，每次看到它，我的心都会因恐惧而剧烈跳动。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
One day, I think it actually possessed me and I ended up
going on a journey. I'm not really sure exactly where though...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
有一天，我觉得它似乎附身了我，我竟然开始了一段旅程。我也不太确定具体去了哪里...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
All I remember was that I was in Lutie, the town of snow. I went over a bridge to a hill to the West...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我只记得我身处姜饼城，那座雪之镇。我走过一座桥，来到了西边的山丘...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
But once I arrived there, I was seized with this feeling of terror I can't explain.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
但当我到达那里时，一种无法形容的恐惧感攫住了我。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I ended up running away.
That's why I gave it to Mr. Enrico. You can laugh at me for being a coward if you want.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
最后我逃跑了。
所以我把它交给了恩里科先生。如果你想嘲笑我是个胆小鬼，那就笑吧。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
You know everything now.
Please leave me alone.
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
现在你什么都知道了。
请让我一个人待着。
^333333*叹息...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'll be waiting.
For some reason, I believe you'll be able to find some sort of clue about what happened these past
two years one of these days.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我会等着的。
不知为何，我相信总有一天你能找到关于过去两年发生之事的线索。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Lohen Phelicia?
The person I asked you to find is Lowen, not Lohen. Lowen Ellenen.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
洛恩·菲丽西亚？
我让你找的人是洛温，不是洛恩。是洛温·艾莱南。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'm sorry
for the trouble,
but I think you
better try again.

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]

[隐士 查尔斯]
我想让你查清她死前那两年发生了什么。我想知道是什么导致了她的死亡。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
What the hell
killed her?!
Don't you understand
the way I feel?
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]

Lowen was a Crusader, a knight in the service of holiness preparing for the Holy War.

about what happened
to Lowen.

[隐士 查尔斯]

他仰慕着她，
她成为了他活下去的理由。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
She will never know that the little boy loved her more than anything else. Unlike the boy, her dream was devote her life to God.
scripts.translation:

她永远不会知道，
这个小男孩爱她胜过一切。
与男孩不同，
她的梦想是将生命奉献给神。

[Hermite Charles]

但他知道，只要能在她身边，
远远地看着她，
他就会感到幸福。

[Hermite Charles]
But one day, because of one fatal mistake, he lost her and she never came back.

[隐士 查尔斯]

因为一个致命的错误，
他失去了她，
她再也没有回来。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Ever since, that boy has been coming to the Sanctuary everyday
to pray for her safety, even into adulthood.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]

那个男孩每天都来到光耀之堂，
为她祈祷平安，
直到成年。

If I weren't this much of a coward, I would already have gone out to find out what I could for myself.

你不懂！
如果我没有这么懦弱，
我早就自己去查明真相了。

我不怕魔物，也不怕死。

这才是我恐惧的：洛温的责备。

All I can do for her is just earnestly pray. I had no idea it'd be so horrible not to be able to see her anymore...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我能为她做的，只有虔诚地祈祷。
我没想到再也见不到她会这么痛苦...

The last time

scripts.translation:

Lowen accompanied

about her since...

请查明任何你能查到的事。
拜托了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I misunderstood you.
I should have realized that people never really listen unless it's of some benefit to them.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我误会你了。
我本该明白，
除非对人们有利，
否则他们根本不会听。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I won't waste any more of
your time. I'll accept Kaili's letter and wait until I find someone who'll listen to
my story and help me.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我不再浪费你的时间了。
我会收下凯利的信，
等待有人愿意听我的故事并帮助我。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
...
^333333*Sob...*^000000
I'm sorry.
I'm so sorry, Lowen.
It was all my fault...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
...
^333333*啜泣...*^000000
对不起。
对不起，洛温。
都是我的错...

scripts.text:

What do you
want from me?
Were you sent by
the Rogue Guild?
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
你想要什么？
你是流氓公会派来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Tell them
I quit already.
Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
告诉他们，
我已经退会了。
别烦我！

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 别管他

scripts.text: Give him Kaili's Letter.

a group of other Crusaders
for the good of the people,
but I haven't heard anything
about her since...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
洛温为了众人的利益，
跟随一群十字军去了那里，
但自那以后，
我就再也没听到过她的消息...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
That was the last time...
Please find out anything
you can. I beg you...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
那是最后一次...
请查明任何你能查到的事。
拜托了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I misunderstood you.
I should have realized that people never really listen unless it's of some benefit to them.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我误会你了。
我本该明白，
除非对人们有利，
否则他们根本不会听。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I won't waste any more of
your time. I'll accept Kaili's letter and wait until I find someone who'll listen to
my story and help me.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我不再浪费你的时间了。
我会收下凯利的信，
等待有人愿意听我的故事并帮助我。

scripts.text:
[Sad-looking Man]
...
^333333*Sob...*^000000
I am so
sorry, Lowen.
It's all fault...

[{0}]
Excuse me.
I am looking
for someone named...
Hermite?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。
我在找一个人...
隐士？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Hm...?
Hermite? That's me.
But if you don't mind,
I want to be alone...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
嗯？
隐士？那就是我。
但是如果不介意的话，
我想一个人待着...

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 别管他

scripts.text: Give him Kaili's Letter.
scripts.translation: 给他凯利的信

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou're not sure why he's so upset, but it doesn't seem to be the best time to try to speak with him. Perhaps later would be better...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你不确定他为什么这么激动，但现在似乎不是和他对话的好时机。也许稍后再试会更好...^000000

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Huh...
Enrico Kaili.
Yeah, I remember
him. So what..?
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
嗯...
恩里科·凯利。
啊，我记得他。
那又怎样？

scripts.text:
^3355FFHermite nonchalantly
tosses the letter back to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF隐士漫不经心地把信扔回给你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
...
^333333*Sigh...*^000000

[Hermite Charles]
You...
Would you like to
listen to my story?
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
你...
想听听我的故事吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: I'm busy, actually.
scripts.translation: 我其实很忙

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Thank you...
Perhaps you're doing this
merely out of consideration,
but I still appreciate your kindness. The story I will
tell you is very old.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
谢谢你...
也许你只是出于礼貌，
但我依然感激你的善意。
我要告诉你的故事，
已经非常久远了。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Long ago, there was a little boy who never knew his parents. Just
to survive, he became a Thief and eventually joined the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
很久以前，有一个从未见过父母的小男孩。
为了生存，他成为了盗贼，
最终加入了流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Without any goals or dreams, his life was pretty aimless. He pretty much only lived so that he could see tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
没有目标，也没有梦想，
他的生活相当迷茫。
他活着，只是为了能看到明天。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
However, the little boy met someone who was full of hope and kindess. He admired her and she became his reason for living.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
然而，这个小男孩遇到了一个充满希望且善良的人。
他仰慕着她，
她成为了他活下去的理由。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
She will never know that the little boy loved her more than anything else. Unlike the boy, her dream was devote her life to God.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
她永远不会知道，
这个小男孩爱她胜过一切。
与男孩不同，
她的梦想是将生命奉献给神。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Although he never understood that, he knew that he would be happy to just be near her, watching from a distance.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
虽然他从未真正理解这一点，
但他知道，只要能在她身边，
远远地看着她，
他就会感到幸福。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
But one day, because of one fatal mistake, he lost her and she never came back.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
但有一天，
因为一个致命的错误，
他失去了她，
她再也没有回来。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Ever since, that boy has been coming to the Sanctuary everyday
to pray for her safety, even into adulthood.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
从那以后，
那个男孩每天都来到光耀之堂，
为她祈祷平安，
直到成年。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
...
^333333*Sob*^000000
Please find
her for me.
Find Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
...
^333333*啜泣*^000000
请帮我找到她。
找到洛温。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I know that Enrico has sent you. I'm guessing he needs something from me. Am I wrong?
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我知道是恩里科派你来的。
我猜他需要我帮个忙。
我猜得没错吧？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'll do whatever you want if you do what I want you to do. It's simple: find out anything you can about Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
如果你答应我的请求，
我就答应你的请求。
很简单：
尽可能多地了解洛温的情况。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
It's doesn't matter how insignificant the clues may be, anything will do. I want to know everything related to her!
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
无论线索多么微不足道，
什么都行。
我想知道与她有关的一切！

scripts.text: Uhhhhh...
Sorry, I can't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不行。

scripts.text: When was the last time you saw her?
scripts.translation: 你最后一次见到她是什么时候？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Please consider my
proposal. If you can
find Lowen for me, I'll
give you what you want.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
请考虑一下我的提议。
如果你能帮我找到洛温，
我会给你你想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Please, I beg you.
You are a strong and well-experienced adventurer. Isn't this a simple thing for you to do?
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
拜托了，我恳求你。
你是一位强大且经验丰富的冒险者。
对你来说，这应该是一件简单的事吧？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
If you've ever dearly loved someone, then you'd know how desperate I am. Please find Lowen for me. Please...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
如果你曾经深爱过某人，
你就会明白我有多绝望。
请帮我找到洛温。
拜托了...

scripts.text: ...Alright.
I'm sorry, I don't think I can do it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我想我做不到。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.
I'll try my best to find her. Would you tell me more about Lowen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。
我会尽力找到她的。
能告诉我更多关于洛温的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
She is a Crusader.
The last time I saw her was
deep inside Geffen Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
她是一名十字军。
我最后一次见到她，
是在吉芬地下城深处。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Long ago, some Crusaders entered the Geffen Dungeon on a monster subjugation expedition.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
很久以前，一些十字军为了平定魔物，
进入了吉芬地下城。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Please find
anything that
you can. I beg
of you...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
请找到
任何你能找到的线索。
拜托了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I understand.
But if you don't help me, then Kaili won't get the help he needs...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
^333333*叹息*^000000
我理解。
但如果你不帮我，凯利就无法得到他需要的帮助了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
You don't understand!
If I weren't this much of a coward, I would already have gone out to find out what I could for myself.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
你不懂！
如果我没有这么懦弱，
我早就自己去查明真相了。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'm not afraid of monsters or dying. It's the fact that she might hate me now. That's what I fear: Lowen's reproach.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我不怕魔物，也不怕死。
我怕的是她现在可能恨我。
这才是我恐惧的：洛温的责备。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
All I can do for her is just earnestly pray. I had no idea it'd be so horrible not to be able to see her anymore...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我能为她做的，只有虔诚地祈祷。
我没想到再也见不到她会这么痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
The last time
I saw her was deep
inside the Geffen Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我最后一次见到她，
是在吉芬地下城深处。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Although it was created by humans, that dungeon is now cursed and inhabited with horrific monsters.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
虽然那座地下城是人类建造的，
但现在它已被诅咒，
栖息着可怕的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'm guessing the Crusaders saw that it was necessary to exterminate the monsters there to keep it from getting even worse.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我猜那些十字军认为，
必须消灭那里的魔物，
以免情况变得更糟。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Lowen accompanied
a group of other Crusaders
for the good of the people,
but I haven't heard anything
about her since...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
洛温为了众人的利益，
跟随一群十字军去了那里，
但自那以后，
我就再也没听到过她的消息...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
That was the last time...
Please find out anything
you can. I beg you...
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
那是最后一次...
请查明任何你能查到的事。
拜托了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I misunderstood you.
I should have realized that people never really listen unless it's of some benefit to them.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我误会你了。
我本该明白，
除非对人们有利，
否则他们根本不会听。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I won't waste any more of
your time. I'll accept Kaili's letter and wait until I find someone who'll listen to
my story and help me.
scripts.translation:
[隐士 查尔斯]
我不再浪费你的时间了。
我会收下凯利的信，
等待有人愿意听我的故事并帮助我。

scripts.text:
[Sad-looking Man]
...
^333333*Sob...*
Lowen...
I'm so sorry.
It's all my fault.
Please be okay...
scripts.translation:
[神情悲伤的男子]
...
^333333*啜泣...*
洛温...
对不起。
都是我的错。
请一定要没事...

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
What are you doing here?
Don't touch anything!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
你在这里做什么？
别乱碰东西！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
What are you doing here?
Don't touch anything!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
你在这里做什么？
别乱碰东西！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Zzzzz...
...Zzzzz...
......Zzzzzz...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
呼噜噜...
...呼噜噜...
......呼噜噜噜...

scripts.text: ^3355FFThis librarian seems to be deeply asleep. It'd be smarter not to wake him if you want to check the Crusader Personnel Records.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这位图书管理员似乎睡得很沉。如果你想查阅十字军人事档案，最好别叫醒他。^000000

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
All confidential personnel records are kept here in the royal library. However, you need authorization
for full access.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
所有机密人事档案都保存在皇家图书馆。不过，你需要获得授权才能完全访问。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Did you say that you
need to find a person?
Please give me that
person's name, as well
as your relationship.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
你说你需要找一个人？
请告诉我那个人的名字，
以及你们的关系。

scripts.text: Lowen, Sibling
scripts.translation: 洛温，兄弟姐妹

scripts.text: Lowen, Spouse
scripts.translation: 洛温，配偶

scripts.text: Lowen, Enemy
scripts.translation: 洛温，敌人

scripts.text: Lowen, a Friend
scripts.translation: 洛温，朋友

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
How dare you
lie to the royal
librarian!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
你竟敢对皇家图书管理员撒谎！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
It says here
in the records
that Lowen did not
have any male siblings!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
档案上写着，
洛温没有任何男性兄弟姐妹！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
^333333(Crap...!
I just disclosed
^666666classified^000000 ^333333info!)^000000

[Librarian]
The Royal Library won't
tolerate identity fraud!
Please leave!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
皇家图书馆绝不容忍身份造假！
请离开！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
You're related to Miss Lowen? How have you not received any news about her before?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
你是洛温小姐的亲属？
之前怎么没收到过关于她的消息？

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
I see...
Separated at birth,
that's truly tragic.
Okay, let me check.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
原来如此...
出生时分离，
真是令人难过。
好的，让我查一下。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
I feel terrible telling you this, but it's too late to find Lowen Ellenen, according to the records.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
很抱歉要告诉你这个，
但根据档案记录，
洛温·艾莱南已经找不到了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
During the monster subjugation mission in Geffen dungeon she reportedly disappeared and... was later pronounced dead.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
据记载，她在吉芬地下城
的魔物讨伐任务中失踪，
后来被宣告死亡。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
I'm sorry, but
that's all I know.
Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
很抱歉，
我只知道这些。
谢谢...

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Spouse...?
Well, I guess you look like a husband. Heh, I've got a girlfriend myself. Well, at least I think so. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
配偶...？
嗯，我看你倒像是个丈夫。
嘿嘿，我自己也有女朋友。
至少我是这么认为的。总之...

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Lowen Ellenen
the Crusader, right?
I'm so... sorry.
You might want
to have a seat.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
洛温·艾莱南，
那位十字军，对吧？
我...很抱歉。
您可能想坐一下。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
During the monster
subjugation in Geffen
Dungeon, she reportedly
disappeared. And later,
she was pronounced dead.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
在吉芬地下城的
魔物讨伐任务中，
她据记载失踪了。
后来，她被宣告死亡。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
That's all the
information I have,
sir. I'm truly sorry
for your loss.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
先生，
这就是我所掌握的全部信息。
对于您的损失，
我深表哀悼。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Hmmm...?
Spouse?
Or ^333333*Ahem*^000000
cohabitational partners?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
嗯...？
配偶？
还是^333333*咳咳*^000000
同居伴侣？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe librarian
now seems awfully
distracted, as if
he were lost in
vivid daydream...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF图书管理员
现在看起来非常心不在焉，
仿佛陷入了
生动的白日梦中...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm looking
for Ellenen.
Lowen Ellenen.
My sworn arch-enemy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在找艾莱南。
洛温·艾莱南。
我的死对头。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Arch-enemy...?
Um, uh ^666666*Ahem!*^000000
All I can tell you is that there was a Crusader by that name.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
死对头...？
呃，嗯^666666*咳咳！*^000000
我只能告诉你，
有一位叫那个名字的十字军。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
I'm sorry, but
I can't tell you
more than that.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
很抱歉，
我无法透露
更多的信息。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
A friend...?
Well, we have a
record of someone
named Lohen Phelica.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
朋友...？
嗯，我们有一个
名叫洛温·菲莉卡的记录。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
He retired from the service a few years ago. I'd like to give you his address, but we don't have any of that information.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
他几年前退役了。
我想给你他的地址，
但我们没有这方面的信息。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Now, may
I excuse myself?
Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
那么，
我可以告辞了吗？
谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
All confidential personnel records are kept here in the royal library. However, you need authorization
for full access.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
所有机密人事档案都保存在皇家图书馆。不过，你需要获得授权才能完全访问。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Hm?
What brings
you here? It's
kind of strange
to come just to
take a walk.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
嗯？
你来这里做什么？
只是来散步
有点奇怪呢。

scripts.text:
[Woman]
Hm?
What brings
you here? It's
kind of strange
to come just to
take a walk.
scripts.translation:
[女子]
嗯？
你来这里做什么？
只是来散步
有点奇怪呢。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Are you the one
who visited me before?
Ah, of course.
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
你是之前来过这里的人吗？
啊，我想起来了。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
I'm not sure how
to tell you this, but...
This is Lowen's grave.
And thank you.
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
我不知道该怎么开口，但是...
这里是洛温的墓。
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
What are you
talking about?
A message from Lowen?
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
你在说什么？
洛温的留言？

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
What?!
Why hasn't she
gone to heaven yet?
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
什么？！
为什么她还没有去往天堂？

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
I hope you remember
everything I'm going
to tell you. She should
go to heaven right now!
I still don't understand...
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
我希望你能记住我接下来要告诉你的话。她应该立刻去往天堂！
我到现在还是不明白...

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
And please tell that praying fool that he shouldn't waste his time blaming himself. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 I still don't know why she chose to
speak to you.
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
还有，请告诉那个只会祈祷的傻瓜，不要浪费时间自责了。^333333*叹息*^000000 我依然不知道她为什么选择与你对话。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Let me tell you something. Lowen was a fencing prodigy. However, she always had trouble enduring the rigorous training and bearing the weight of the armor...
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
让我告诉你一些事情。洛温是个击剑天才。然而，她总是难以忍受严苛的训练，也承受不了盔甲的重量...

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
But she loved fencing and always tried twice as hard to develop her physical strength so that she could serve God in battle.
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
但她热爱击剑，总是加倍努力锻炼体能，以便能在战斗中侍奉神。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Finally, she became a Crusader.
For a while things were great, but then she suddenly disappeared while on a mission to Geffen Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
最终，她成为了一名十字军。
有一段时间一切都很顺利，但后来她在执行前往吉芬地下城的任务时突然失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Two years later, she was buried in this grave after her body was found by some adventurers. I was given the broken shards of armor and a blood stained ribbon she left behind.
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
两年后，她的遗体被一些冒险者发现，并安葬在这座墓中。我收到了她留下的破碎盔甲碎片和一条染血的丝带。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
I never really learned what exactly happened. And Hermite was always following her like she was his real sister. Ever since she died, he's changed. I hope he doesn't hurt himself...
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
我始终没能弄清到底发生了什么。隐士一直像对待亲姐姐一样跟着她。自从她死后，他就变了。我希望他不会伤害自己...

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Something suspicious seems to have happened in the military, but they won't even talk to me about it. What could have happened?!
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
军队里似乎发生了一些可疑的事情，但他们甚至不肯跟我谈。到底发生了什么？！

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
In the end, I gave up trying to find the truth. After all, nothing can bring her back...
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
最后，我放弃了寻找真相。毕竟，没有什么能让她复活...

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Please tell her I'm fine,
but I want to know why her
soul hasn't moved on to
heaven! Maybe...
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
请告诉她我很好，
但我想知道为什么她的灵魂
还没有去往天堂！也许...

scripts.text:
[Rose Ellenen]
Maybe there's
something in the
Crusader Personnel
Records that might
explain something?
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
也许十字军的人事档案
里有什么能解释这一切？

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
This is my little
sister's grave...
Her name was Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
这是我妹妹的墓...
她的名字叫洛温。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Are you a friend
of Lowen's? Hmmm?
The man in the Sanctuary?
That must be Hermite.
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
你是洛温的朋友吗？嗯？
在光耀之堂里的那个男人？
那一定是隐士。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
He was shocked when Lowen
died but he doesn't have to blame himself for her death. I don't want him to suffer from the guilt.
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
洛温去世时他受到了很大的打击，但他不必为她的死自责。我不希望他被愧疚折磨。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Anyway, thank you for visiting
my little sister. It's good to know she has friends, even after she's passed on.
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
总之，谢谢你来看望我的妹妹。知道她即使去世后也有朋友，我很欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Oh hello...
Have you come
to pay your respects
to someone here as well?
scripts.translation:
[萝丝·艾莱南]
哦，你好...
你是来向这里
的某人致敬的吗？

scripts.text:
Lowen Ellenen
 
 XXXX. XX. XX.
Her noble spirit
was sent to the holy
place by Valkyrie's will.
scripts.translation:
洛温·艾莱南

XXXX. XX. XX.
她高贵的灵魂
受瓦尔基里之命
被送往了圣地。
