scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Can you see me now?
You must be surprised.
This is the story I will
share with you.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
你现在能看见我了吗？
你一定很惊讶。
这就是我要与你分享的故事。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Look around.
Recognize it?
We're still in the same place, except now we're in my past.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
看看四周。
认出来了吗？
我们还在同一个地方，只是现在回到了我的过去。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
All of us came here to Geffen to cleanse this area of evil spirits. You asked for the reason I remained in this awful place?
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
我们所有人都来到吉芬，为了净化这片区域的邪恶灵魂。你想知道我为什么留在这个可怕的地方吗？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I couldn't forgive myself for what I've done to my comrades. They
were killed because of me.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
我无法原谅自己对同志们所做的一切。他们是因为我才死的。

scripts.text: You were cursed...?
scripts.translation: 你被诅咒了...？

scripts.text: You still have something to do.
scripts.translation: 你还有事要做。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're saying...
The anger of your
comrades manifested
into a curse?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是说...
同志们心中的愤怒
化作了诅咒？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Cursed by my fallen comrades... Yes, that's what I thought at first. So I tried to redeem myself as well as avenge their deaths.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
被牺牲的同志们诅咒...起初我是这么想的。所以我试图赎罪，并为他们的死复仇。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I have been trying my best to comfort their spirits for 2 years.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
两年来，我一直尽力安抚他们的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ever since you guys failed on a mission, you've spent two years here killing monsters?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
自从你们任务失败后，你就在这里杀了两年魔物？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Yes, that's right.
I thought it would bring comfort to the spirits of my comrades.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
是的，没错。
我以为这样能安抚同志们灵魂的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
But once I died, I met all of my old friends in Niflheim, the town of the dead. You've heard of it, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
但当我死后，我在尼弗海姆——亡者之镇，见到了我所有的老朋友。你听说过那里，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
No one seemed to
blame me for what
had happened. In fact, they all seemed worried about me.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
没有人责怪我发生了什么事。事实上，他们似乎都在担心我。

scripts.text: Then why?
scripts.translation: 那是为什么？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
They waited for me in Niflheim for two years, since they didn't want me to misunderstand them. They never blamed me for what happened.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
他们在尼弗海姆等了我两年，因为他们不想让我误解他们。他们从未责怪我发生了什么事。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
But I still feel like something is wrong. Out of all of us, I'm the only one unable to rest in peace. Everyone else was selected to go to Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
但我总觉得有什么不对劲。在我们所有人中，只有我一个人无法安息。其他人都被选中前往英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
But Valhalla is where all honorable Crusaders are supposed to go. What have I done wrong?
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
但英灵殿是所有光荣的十字军应该去的地方。我做错了什么？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I don't think I have any unfinished business. But who knows, maybe there is something I have to do.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
我不认为我有什么未了的心愿。但谁知道呢，也许有什么事是我必须做的。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
All of my late comrades that I met in Niflheim were selected by Valkyrie and sent to Valhalla. That's how honorable Crusaders spend the afterlife. But it looks like I don't deserve it...
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
我在尼弗海姆遇到的所有已故同志，都被瓦尔基里选中送往英灵殿。这就是光荣的十字军度过来世的方式。但看起来我不配得到它...

scripts.text: I can help you!
scripts.translation: 我可以帮你！

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
You can
help me?
How...?
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
你...能帮我？
怎么...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said this is the place where the subjugation mission happened, right? I'll fight with you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你说这里是镇压任务发生的地方，对吧？我会和你一起战斗！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now come on, you don't deserve to feel guilty like this. Let's think about how we're gonna fight these monsters!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了，你不应该像这样感到内疚。让我们想想怎么对付这些魔物！

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
...
Thank you.
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
...
谢谢你。
非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

shall we go in?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，

Walk down the stairs
ahead. From this point
I can only travel with
you in your mind...

scripts.text:

How come...
You're here?
scripts.translation:

It wasn't any trouble

We've got problems now.

我们现在遇到了问题。

[{0}]

Doppelganger?!

[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

The commander gave orders
and then... What happened?

指挥官下达了命令，然后...发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I was a fool.
Now I remember Hermite. He must have been the one who rescued me. But when I came to my senses, no one was there.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
我真傻。
现在我想起来了，是隐士救了我。但当我恢复意识时，那里已经没有人了。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I blamed myself for surviving alone. I should have died there with my friends. I felt so useless.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
我责怪自己独自活了下来。我应该和朋友们一起死在那里。我觉得自己毫无用处。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Now I realize that there were many people who loved me. But at the time, I felt only guilt.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
现在我意识到，有很多人是爱我的。但当时，我只感受到了愧疚。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I returned 3 days later to my commander. It was stupid, but at the moment I couldn't think of anything else.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
三天后，我回到了指挥官面前。
虽然很愚蠢，但当时我实在想不出别的办法。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
The higher ups and the politicians were looking for a scapegoat for the failure of the mission.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
高层和政客们正在为这次任务的失败寻找替罪羔羊。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
So I was the one who was blamed. Then, they took away everything I had. My status, the holy power granted to me...
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
于是，所有的罪责都落在了我身上。
随后，他们夺走了我拥有的一切。我的地位，赐予我的神圣力量...

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I thought I deserved that punishment. After all, why should
I have survived when all my comrades died?
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
我曾以为那是应得的惩罚。
毕竟，当所有同志都牺牲了，为什么只有我活了下来？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
It was then that I decided to avenge my friends, and salvage
what was left of my sense of honor.
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
就在那时，我决定为朋友们复仇，
并挽回我仅存的一点荣誉。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I went back to that place.
I fought and I fought, trying to make penance for what I had
done wrong...
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
我回到了那个地方。
我不断地战斗，试图为我所犯下的错误赎罪...

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
That voice...
Isn't that...?
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
那个声音...
难道不是...？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Are you giving me another chance? But I no longer have a body to fight monsters anymore...
scripts.translation:
[洛温·艾莱南]
你是在给我第二次机会吗？
但我已经没有身体去战斗魔物了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]

[{0}]

the test, Lowen.

time to speak.
scripts.translation:

[Valkyrie]
Have you found the strength to release yourself from the guilt and the pain? I have been waiting for you. Will you accept my invitation to Valhalla?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
你找到了从愧疚和痛苦中解脱的力量吗？

你愿意接受我前往英灵殿的邀请吗？

scripts.translation: 是的，我会跟随你

scripts.text: Um... I'm not Lowen.

[Valkyrie]

to Einherjar with
the will of God.
scripts.translation:

洛温·艾莱南，被误解的英雄。
我将以神的意志，晋升你为英灵战士。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Your soul and spirit will be reborn in Valhalla as a holy warrior preparing for the holy war.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
你的灵魂与精神将在英灵殿重生，
成为为圣战做准备的神圣战士。

[Valkyrie]
And...
{0},

scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
还有...
{0}，

The story begins a long, long time ago with Freya, the patron goddess of beauty and love.

故事要从很久很久以前说起，
始于美丽与爱之神弗雷亚。

Her teardrop became a beautiful jewel. The snow on which Freya's teardrops have fallen will always retain its crystalline beauty.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
她的泪滴化作了美丽的宝石。
凡是被弗雷亚泪滴触及的雪花，都将永远保留其结晶之美。

[Valkyrie]
You seek traces of the goddess? Perhaps this is a sign of the end of the thousand year peace. When the time comes, I hope humans will not abandon their faith.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
你在寻找女神的痕迹吗？
也许这是千年和平终结的征兆。
当那一刻来临时，我希望人类不会放弃他们的信仰。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Perhaps, I was also sent to meet you. I wish that humans will use the power derived from the traces of the gods to protect justice.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
也许，我来到你面前也是命中注定。
我希望人类能利用源自神迹的力量，守护正义。

A narrow path the goddess passed.
Four dwarves that the goddess met...

女神渡过的蓝色河流。
女神经过的狭窄小径。
女神遇见的四位矮人...

scripts.text:

For Odin's honor...

made me laugh.

能让我发笑了。

scripts.text:
[Old dwarf]
Who are you?!
And why the hell
did you wake me up?
scripts.translation:
[年迈的矮人]
你是谁？！
你他妈的
为什么吵醒我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
Nothing happened.
Did I do something wrong, or is this just a completely ordinary puzzle cube?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
什么都没发生。
是我做错了什么，
还是这只是一个普通的魔方？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This...
This better not
be just some regular
puzzle cube that someone
just dropped in the snow!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这...
这最好不是某人
随手丢在雪里的
普通魔方！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou use your finger to poke the pile of snow. However, you hurt your finger a little bit after hitting something really solid.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你用手指戳了戳那堆雪。然而，碰到某个坚硬的东西后，你的手指有点疼。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA lot of snow
is heavily piled
here on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里的地面上
堆积着厚厚的积雪。^000000

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
I've got nothing
more to say! Now
get out of here!
I don't want to
be found!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
我没什么
好说的了！
现在滚出去！
我不想被找到！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
What's up, human?
All of us have awakened.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
怎么了，人类？
我们都醒了。

scripts.text: I just wanted to say hello.
scripts.translation: 只是想打个招呼

scripts.text: What are Brisingamen's materials?
scripts.translation: 女神项链的材料是什么？

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Your gesture is appreciated, but I'd rather hide than socialize. I don't want to be found by the crows of Odin!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
感谢你的好意，但我宁愿躲起来也不愿社交。我不想被奥丁的乌鸦发现！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Materials for Brisingamen? For the human imitation, the materials are pretty easy to gather...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
女神项链的材料？对于人类仿制品来说，材料很容易收集...

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
The power of weapons used by gods, when they battled demons a thousand years ago, and everything detached from Brisingamen. That's basically what you need.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
一千年前众神与恶魔战斗时使用的武器之力，以及从女神项链上脱落的一切。基本上就是这些。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
If you want to
create a Brisingamen,
you will need.....
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
如果你想
制作女神项链，
你需要.....

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
^4d4dffFreya's Jewel
Silver Ornament
Snow Crystal
Ripple
Drifting Air^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
^4d4dff菲力亚宝石
银饰品
雪的结晶
涟漪
空气雕像^000000

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
You might need some gems, like Saphire, Peal, Opal, Curse Ruby, and maybe even some Gold to decorate the necklace.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
你可能还需要一些宝石，比如蓝宝石、珍珠、蛋白石、诅咒红宝石，甚至可能还需要一些黄金来装饰项链。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Although I give freely of my advice, we four Dwarves will no longer do smithing work unless it be Freya's command.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
虽然我乐意提供建议，但我们四个矮人除非奉弗丽雅之命，否则不会再从事锻造工作了。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
But I can promise you one thing. Since the four of us have awakened, humans will obtain the Brisingamen for sure.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
但我可以向你保证一件事。既然我们四人都已苏醒，人类必定能打造出女神项链。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Now...
Leave me
in peace.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
好了...
请让我
安静一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's been a long time since I've been outside! W-wait! You're not...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
^333333*哈欠...*^000000
我已经很久没到外面来了！等...等等！你不是...

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Who sent you?!
Loki? Heimdall?
Or was it Freya?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
是谁派你来的？！
洛基？海姆达尔？
还是弗丽雅？

scripts.text: No one, it was an accident!
scripts.translation: 没人，纯属意外！

scripts.text: It was Valkyrie.
scripts.translation: 是瓦尔基里。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Don't even think of lying to me, human! There's no way you could have awoken me without knowing
the password! Now, speak!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
别想骗我，人类！没有口令你根本不可能唤醒我！现在，说！

scripts.text: Valkyrie told me.
scripts.translation: 是瓦尔基里告诉我的。

scripts.text: It was a coincidence!
scripts.translation: 纯属巧合！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Valkyrie...?
Odin's warmonger?
What could Odin want,
I haven't done anything wrong!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
瓦尔基里...？
奥丁的战争狂人？
奥丁想干什么，我什么都没做错啊！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou explained everything to Alfrik, who seems to worry about being targeted by Odin.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向阿尔弗里克解释了一切，他似乎很担心会被奥丁盯上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
So that's it.
Seeking out our
masterpiece? You
humans must desire
the power of the gods.
Interesting.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
原来如此。
寻找我们的
杰作？你们人类
一定渴望
神的力量。
有意思。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
The time for us to revive may actually have come! Alright then,
I, Alfrik shall cooperate with you humans.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
我们复活的时刻可能真的到了！好吧，
我，阿尔弗里克，愿意与你们人类合作。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
After all, getting on Odin's good side like this is much better than being tortured by Loki.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
毕竟，像这样讨好奥丁，总比被洛基折磨要好得多。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Now...
Understand that
there can only be
one true Brisingamen.
After all, it's our
masterpiece.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
现在...
你要明白，
真正的女神项链
只能有一条。
毕竟，那是我们的
杰作。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
However, that doesn't mean an imitation, with the same power as that godly item, can't be made. Isn't it tempting, the power of a god?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
不过，这并不意味着无法制作出拥有同等神力的仿制品。神的力量，难道不诱人吗？

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
First things first. If you want to make the necklace, you must
awaken all four of us. Because of Loki's threat, we all hid ourselves in different places.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
首先，如果你想打造项链，必须唤醒我们四个人。因为洛基的威胁，我们各自藏身在不同的地方。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Go wake all my brothers!
Let's see if the Brisingamen can be made once again! First, go and wake Dvalin before the gods and giants find out!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
去唤醒我所有的兄弟！
让我们看看女神项链能否再次被打造出来！首先，赶在众神和巨人发现之前，先去唤醒德瓦林！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Coincidence?
Impossible! How dare you lie! Don't ever come back, or the gods will find me!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
巧合？
不可能！你竟敢撒谎！别再回来了，否则众神会找到我的！

[Alfrik]
Why are you still here?
I told you go wake Dvalin!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
你怎么还在这里？
我让你去唤醒德瓦林！

scripts.text: Where is he?
scripts.translation: 他在哪里？

scripts.text: Tell me more about Brisingamen.
scripts.translation: 多告诉我一些关于女神项链的事。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Ah. Right.
I forgot to tell
you. Poor Dvalin.
Now, where was it?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
啊，对。
我忘了告诉你。
可怜的德瓦林。
嗯，他在哪里来着？

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
We were afraid that Odin and Heimdall would punish us because, well, in their eyes we disgraced the goddess.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
我们害怕奥丁和海姆达尔会惩罚我们，因为，嗯，在他们眼里，我们让女神蒙羞了。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Oh course, they never would have been angered if it weren't for Loki's trickery.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
当然，如果不是洛基的诡计，他们本来是不会生气的。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
We loved Freya so much that we decided to hide ourselves beneath the path that she walked. To be as close to any trace of her as we could.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
我们如此深爱芙蕾雅，以至于决定藏身在她走过的道路之下。为了尽可能靠近她留下的痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Poor Dvalin is sleeping
under the path in the East. Once there, you'll feel the scent the goddess. I can't remember where the others are sleeping, but you cannot forget these words...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
可怜的德瓦林正睡在东边的道路下面。到了那里，你会闻到女神的气息。我不记得其他人睡在哪里了，但你不能忘记这些话...

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
^4d4dffHer lovely scent
Still lingers in the wind.
We surrendered our hearts
To those tender teardrops
Those seductive red lips.^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
^4d4dff她迷人的芬芳
仍随风飘散。
我们献出了心
为了那温柔的泪滴
那诱人的红唇。^000000

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Brisingamen is our masterpiece, a necklace we forged for Freya. Even if we tried making it again, I doubt it would be as good.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
女神项链是我们的杰作，是我们为芙蕾雅打造的项链。即使我们再次尝试制作，恐怕也不会有原来那么好。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
It looked perfect on Freya. Very difficult to create jewelry that actually enhances the attractiveness of the goddess of beauty.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
它戴在芙蕾雅身上完美无瑕。很难打造出能真正提升美丽女神魅力的珠宝。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Perhaps our greatest reward was that beautiful smile of satisfaction she gave us when that we gave her that necklace. We loved her so.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
也许我们最大的奖赏，就是当我们把项链送给她时，她露出的那抹满足而美丽的微笑。我们如此爱她。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Is it that wrong for dwarves to love a goddess? Perhaps we were punished because the gods, even Odin, loved her as well.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
矮人爱上一位女神有什么错吗？也许我们受到惩罚，是因为众神，甚至奥丁，也爱着她。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
In any case, we've never seen the true Brisingamen again. But something very similar to it can be created...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
无论如何，我们再也没见过真正的女神项链。但可以制作出非常相似的东西...

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
You'll need materials that have been graced by the goddess' presense. Traces of the goddess in the earth, water and the wind.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
你需要那些被女神气息眷顾的材料。女神在大地、水和风中留下的痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
And if the Brisingamen is recreated, the power of a god will be in the hands of a human. That human could be you!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
如果女神项链被重新打造，神的力量将掌握在一个人类手中。那个人类可能就是你！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Poor Dvalin is sleeping under the path in the East. Once there, you'll feel the scent the goddess.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
可怜的德瓦林正睡在东边的道路下面。到了那里，你会闻到女神的气息。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
I can't remember where the others are sleeping, but you cannot forget these words...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
我不记得其他人睡在哪里了，但你不能忘记这些话...

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
^4d4dffHer lovely scent
Still lingers in the wind.
We surrendered our hearts
To those tender teardrops
Those seductive red lips.^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
^4d4dff她迷人的芬芳
仍随风飘散。
我们献出了心
为了那温柔的泪滴
那诱人的红唇。^000000

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Will you please!
Get lost before Loki and Heimdall find out I've awakened! Now hurry, find Dvalin, and wake him up!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
求你了！
在洛基和海姆达尔发现我醒来之前快离开！快去吧，找到德瓦林，唤醒他！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Oh, finally all of us have awakened! Now, the power of the goddess can be retrieved from the earth, water and the wind!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
哦，终于，我们全都苏醒了！现在，女神的力量可以从大地、水和风中获取了！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Hahahahaha!
This should be
interesting!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
哈哈哈哈！
这下有意思了！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Mmm...?
I've got
no business
with you.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔弗里克]
嗯...？
我跟你没什么
关系。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's just an
ordinary rock.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只是一块
普通的石头。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's just an
ordinary rock.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只是一块
普通的石头。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's just an ordinary rock underneath the shadow of
a tree. But on closer inspection, you notice that the moss on top of the rock looks perfectly flat.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这只是一块树荫下的普通石头。但仔细观察，你会发现石头上的苔藓看起来非常平整。^000000

scripts.text: Step on it.
scripts.translation: 踩上去

scripts.text: Sweep the surface.
scripts.translation: 扫开表面

scripts.text: Scratch the surface.
scripts.translation: 刮擦表面

scripts.text: Kick it.
scripts.translation: 踢它

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gingerly place your foot on the top of the stone. The entire rock suddenly swings downward
into the ground, and you fall helplessly...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你小心翼翼地踩在石头上。整块石头突然向下沉入地面，你无助地掉了下去...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFAs you sweep away the moss with your hand, you scratch your palm from the sharp edges of the rock.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF当你用手扫开苔藓时，手掌被石头锋利的边缘划伤了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Damn...!
I'm bleeding!
But why didn't
anything else
happen?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
该死...！
我流血了！
但为什么
没有发生
其他事情？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This rock had
better be one of
those secret rocks!
Or else...!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这块石头
最好是一块
秘密石头！
否则...！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou scratch away
at the moss, and feel that the surface of the rock has even recesses.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你刮开苔藓，感觉到石头表面有凹陷。

scripts.text: ^3355FFAfter peeling off the moss, a series of tiles, etched with faint words, are revealed on top of the rock. These tiles could be moved around, like in a puzzle.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF剥掉苔藓后，石头顶部露出了一系列刻有淡淡文字的瓷砖。这些瓷砖可以像拼图一样移动。^000000

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
又是谜题？
这就像之前要给阿尔弗里克密码时一样。好吧，让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
...?
Alfrik?
Is that you?
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
...？
阿尔弗里克？
是你吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333*Cough cough!*
Aaaack!
It's so dusty!

^3355FFJust a normal
rock, covered in moss.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF只是一块长满青苔的岩石而已。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
A human?
You woke me up?
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
人类？
是你吵醒我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Hmm...
And you'd be acting pretty pushy right about now if you were acting on behalf of a god. What could you want...?
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
嗯...
如果你代表某位神明，现在应该会很强势才对。你想要什么...？

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
It makes sense that you want a replica of Brisingamen for its power. But remember, we originally made Brisingamen as a necklace fit for a goddess.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
想要复制品是为了它的力量，这说得通。但请记住，我们最初制作女神项链，是为了献给女神。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Some might say that we seduced Freya with the necklace, but we really loved her with all of our hearts.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
也许有人会说我们用项链诱惑了芙蕾雅，但我们其实是全心全意爱着她的。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Wah, it's not Alfrik?
Who are you to wake Dvalin?
Tell me right now, or I'll...
I'll kick your ass!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
哇，不是阿尔弗里克？
你算哪根葱，敢吵醒德瓦林？
现在就说，不然...
不然我就揍扁你！

scripts.text: Help!
scripts.translation: 救命！

scripts.text: Alfrik sent me to wake you up!
scripts.translation: 是阿尔弗里克派我来叫醒你的！

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
I don't know
what the hell
you're doing here,
but leave!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
我不知道你在这里
搞什么鬼，
但给我滚！

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Did you just say Alfrik sent you? How do you know my brother?!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
你刚才说阿尔弗里克派你来的？你怎么认识我哥哥？！

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Brisingamen?!
Then, that means
we can meet Freya again?!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
女神项链？！
那么，
我们就能再见到芙蕾雅了吗？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm...
I'm afraid not.
Or, at least, that's
not why I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
恐怕不是。
至少，
这不是我来的原因。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Okay...
I understand.
Sorry, I was just
hoping you were a
herald of Freya.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
好吧...
我明白了。
抱歉，
我只是希望你是
芙蕾雅的使者。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
So, an imitation
of Brisingamen...
Even if it's not the original, I'm sure it can possess power comparable to the real thing. Yes...
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
所以，是女神项链的仿制品...
即使不是原件，我相信它也能拥有与真品相当的力量。是的...

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
It's no use trying to predict the future, but I can't help but wonder what would mankind do with the power of the gods?
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
试图预测未来是没有用的，但我忍不住想知道，人类会如何利用神的力量？

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
If my brother Alfrik already approved of you, then I'll help you out. I'll tell you how to wake my brother Berling.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
既然我哥哥阿尔弗里克已经认可了你，那我会帮你的。我会告诉你如何唤醒我哥哥贝林。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
We hid ourselves near traces of Freya. The path where I am staying is one that my goddess has walked through.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
我们隐藏在芙蕾雅留下的痕迹附近。我居住的地方，是女神曾经走过的路。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
The air that quietly drifts here holds her fragrant scent. You can use this wind to borrow her power.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
这里静静飘浮的空气里，带着她芬芳的气息。
你可以借助这风，借用她的力量。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Aside from Freya, I have
no special love for the gods or giants. But I am intrigued by you humans. Your race is one of both love and hatred, life and destruction.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
除了芙蕾雅，我对其他的神或巨人并没有特别的感情。
但我对人类很感兴趣。
你们这个种族，既充满爱与恨，也兼具生与灭。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Go now and seek Berling. He is sleeping near a river linked to Mount Mjolnir. Travel West to find the river were Freya's Teardrops have fallen.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
去吧，去找贝林。
他正睡在雷神之锤山附近的一条河边。
往西走，找到那条落有芙蕾雅之泪的河流。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
If the phantom of water gives you a question, answer it. The answer is the punishment that Odin gave to our goddess.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
如果水的幻影向你提问，请回答它。
那个答案，就是奥丁赐予我们女神的惩罚。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Until thousands of Valkyries filled up Valhala, they had to repeatedly live, die, then be reborn the next day only to die again.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
直到成千上万的瓦尔基里填满英灵殿，
她们不得不反复经历生与死，
第二天重生，却又再次死去。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Think about
who they were.
That's all I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
想想她们是谁。
我只能告诉你这些。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Somehow, I know
you are the one who
can answer the question.
Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
不知为何，我知道你就是那个能回答这个问题的人。
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Why do you keep calling me? I did everything I can do for you. I even gave you the key to the question.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
你为什么一直叫我？
我已经为你做了一切。
我甚至给了你问题的钥匙。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
From now on,
it's all up to you.
Now, go wake Berling...
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
从现在开始，
一切由你自己决定。
现在，去唤醒贝林...

scripts.translation: ^3355FF看着这条潺潺流动的溪流，让人心旷神怡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
Alfrik: confirmed.
Dvalin: confirmed.
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
阿尔弗里克：确认。
德瓦林：确认。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
Please answer me.
Odin punished beautiful
Freya, and made her curse
some humans with her power.
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
请回答我。
奥丁惩罚了美丽的芙蕾雅，
让她用她的力量诅咒了一些人类。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
Freya caused an eternal battle, where the combatants were all killed and brought back to life everyday. How many humans were cursed to participate?
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
芙蕾雅引发了一场永恒的战争，
参战者每天都被杀死，然后又复活。
有多少人类被诅咒参与其中？

scripts.text: How should I know?!
scripts.translation: 我怎么知道？！

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
Failed.
Failed...
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
失败。
失败...

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
Failed.
Failed...
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
失败。
失败...

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
Failed.
Failed...
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
失败。
失败...

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
...Confirmed.
Shutting down barrier.
Initiating summoning.
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
...确认。
关闭屏障。
启动召唤。

scripts.text:
[Berling]
^333333*Gasp--!*^000000
Thought I was
gonna drown to death!
Who woke me up?
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
^333333*喘气——！*^000000
我差点淹死了！
是谁把我弄醒的？

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe sight of this bubbling stream refreshes you just by looking at it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看着这条潺潺流动的溪流，让人心旷神怡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Berling]
You're the one that's awakened us? Hahaha, perhaps that's a sign we may see Freya again! Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
是你唤醒了我们？哈哈，这或许是个好兆头，我们又能见到芙蕾雅了！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Berling]
We are indebted to you for reviving us. Okay, I know what you want, and will help you obtain the power of the gods.
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
我们要感谢你将我们复活。好吧，我知道你想要什么，我会帮你获得神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Berling]
What the...?
It's a human?!
What do you want?
Wh-who are you?
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
什么...？
是人类？！
你想干什么？
你...你是谁？

scripts.text: Dvalin wants you to wake up!
scripts.translation: 德瓦林让你把他叫醒！

scripts.text: Tell me who you are first!
scripts.translation: 先告诉我你是谁！

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Dvalin?!
You mean my brother!
But he can only be revived if Alfrik is revived. What happened?
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
德瓦林？！
你是说我哥哥！
但他只有在阿尔弗里克复活后才能复活。发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm...
Let me explain...

[{0}]
...So I guess I need to wake up all four of you dwarves so that Brisingamen, which holds Freya's power, can be made again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...看来我需要唤醒你们四个矮人，这样就能重新打造蕴含芙蕾雅力量的女神项链了。

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Oh! Say that name once again! Freya, the goddess who took my body and soul! Did you just say you want to make her necklace?
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
哦！再叫一次那个名字！夺走我身体和灵魂的芙蕾雅！你刚才说想打造她的项链？

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Hahahaha!
Stop joking around.
The Brisingamen is
a one of a kind
masterpiece!
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
哈哈哈！
别开玩笑了。
女神项链是
独一无二的
杰作！

scripts.text: I don't mean the original one, but...
scripts.translation: 我不是指原本的那条，而是...

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Ah, now I see! You want a replica that has roughly the same power.
A Brisingamen used by humans!
Very clever!
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
啊，我明白了！你想要一个拥有大致相同力量的复制品。
供人类使用的女神项链！
真是聪明！

scripts.text:
[Berling]
I, on the other hand, do not desire power. I would be happy to own but a strand of my goddess' hair.
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
而我，并不渴望力量。如果能拥有一缕女神的头发，我就心满意足了。

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Oh Freya...
The more of her beauty exists in this world, the happier I'll be. I'm more than willing to help you recreate this memento of Freya.
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
芙蕾雅...
这世上多一分她的美丽，我就多一分快乐。我非常乐意帮你重现这件芙蕾雅的遗物。

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Now, please go and find the last one of my brothers! Poor Grer, perhaps he is still digging silver in that mine for her...
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
现在，请去找我兄弟中的最后一位吧！可怜的格雷尔，也许他还在矿里为她挖银矿...

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Go and find Grer. I will give you Freya's golden teardrop, but he might have revived on his own...
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
去找格雷尔吧。我会给你芙蕾雅的金色泪滴，但他可能已经自己复活了...

scripts.text:
[Berling]
If he doesn't trust you, sing this song. You must remember each
and every word...
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
如果他不信任你，就唱这首歌。你必须记住
每一个字...

scripts.text:
[Berling]
^4d4dffNo jewel in the world can compare.^000000
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
^4d4dff世间珠宝，无一可比。^000000

scripts.text:
[Berling]
^4d4dffOur masterpiece made from love.^000000
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
^4d4dff我们倾注爱意打造的杰作。^000000

scripts.text:

^4d4dffShe wanted the dazzling necklace.^000000
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
^4d4dff她想要那条耀眼的项链。^000000

scripts.text:

^4d4dffWe wanted the goddess of beauty.^000000
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
^4d4dff我们想要的是美丽的女神。^000000

scripts.text:
[Berling]
^4d4dffOur happiest times were with her.^000000
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
^4d4dff和她在一起的日子最快乐。^000000

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Memorize all five lines of this song exactly. Now take this golden teardrop and please seek out Grer.
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
把这五句歌词一字不差地记下来。现在拿着这颗金色泪滴，去找格雷尔吧。

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Where the hell
did you come from?
I, Berling, refuse to
give my name to a rude,
ill-bred human like yourself!
scripts.translation:
[贝林]
你从哪冒出来的？
我，贝林，拒绝向像你这样粗鲁无礼的人类透露姓名！

Quiet you!
Mind your own

scripts.translation:

嗷呜！
闭嘴！
管好你自己！

scripts.text:

Did you already forget the lyrics? Let me tell them to you again, so don't forget this time.

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Don't come any closer!
How the hell do I feel
Freya's presense on you?
Tell me who you are!
scripts.translation:
[男性的声音]
别过来！
我为什么能感受到
你身上有芙蕾雅的气息？
告诉我你是谁！

scripts.text: I am sent by Berling.
scripts.translation: 我是贝林派来的。

scripts.text: Wah, you freaked me out!
scripts.translation: 哇，你吓到我了！

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Lies! Lies!
Prove it!
Prove yourself!
scripts.translation:
[男性的声音]
谎言！全是谎言！
证明给我看！
证明你自己！

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[男性的声音]
滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Prove it!
Otherwise, leave me alone and let me mine silver. Silver...! Heh heh heh...
scripts.translation:
[男性的声音]
证明给我看！
否则就离我远点，让我挖银矿。银矿...！嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Grer]
As we promised,
Brisingamen will appear in front of human's eyes. But until then, I shall make jewelry of silver. Mwahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
正如我们所承诺的，
女神项链会在人类眼前显现。但在那之前，我要用银制作首饰。哇哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Grer]
My name is Grer.
I should have been
the last one to be awakened. Now I see that I haven't mined as much silver as I may need.
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
我的名字是格雷尔。
我本应是最后一个被唤醒的。现在我发现，我挖的银矿还不够多。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
You might think gold would better suit a goddess, but no. Silver is what makes her golden hair more beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
你可能觉得黄金更适合女神，但不对。银才能让她的金色头发更加美丽。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Now that we're revived, there's a good chance that we may see her again. I don't really mind anything else.
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
既然我们复活了，就有机会再次见到她。其他的事我都不在意。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
I want her spirit and scent to fill this world. I don't want Odin or Heimdall to know our plan.
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
我要让她的灵魂和气息充满这个世界。我不希望奥丁或海姆达尔知道我们的计划。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Now, this doesn't mean
that I prefer humans over
gods or giants, but if it's for Freya, I'll do anything.
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
现在，这并不意味着
我比神或巨人更偏爱人类，但如果是为了芙蕾雅，我会做任何事。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Anyway, now my brothers
have been revived. For that, I give you my thanks. Someday, you will have the power to challenge the gods.
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
总之，现在我的兄弟们
已经复活了。为此，我感谢你们。总有一天，你们将拥有挑战诸神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Now, I need to
get back to my work.
You'll need a silver ornament for the necklace, so I'll continue to mine silver.
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
现在，我需要
回去工作了。
项链需要银饰品，所以我会继续挖银矿。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
I will be working
hard to make the most
beautiful ornament
in the world.
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
我会努力工作，
制作出世界上最美丽的
饰品。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Okay, you
may go back now!
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
好了，你
可以回去了！
再见。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Heh heh...
Why are you still
here? Your job is done.
Now, go back to where
you came from!
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
嘿嘿...
你为什么还在这里？你的任务已经完成了。
现在，回到你来的地方去！

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Who the
hell are you?!
scripts.translation:
[格雷尔]
你他妈的
是谁？！
